https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u_M7IUHMXKk

值得閱讀的理由

  • 掌握小米首款登台大型家電「米家滾筒洗脫烘 Pro」的核心規格、市場定位與極具競爭力的性價比優勢。
  • 深入了解直驅變頻馬達（DD 馬達）與智慧雙槽自動洗劑投放系統如何大幅提升洗衣品質與日常便利性。
  • 全面解析智慧稱重、APP 遠端控制以及超過 30 種洗滌模式等智慧家庭生態鏈帶來的全方位升級體驗。

摘要

小米首款大型家電登場：極致性價比與超長保固

作者介紹了小米正式進軍台灣大型家電市場的首款代表作——米家滾筒洗脫烘 Pro。這款產品主打「越級」的高規格配置，核心採用成本較高但運作更安靜、更穩定的直驅變頻馬達（DD 馬達）。為了展現對產品質量的信心，小米祭出了長達 12 年馬達保固以及 2 年全機保固，再搭配 NT$16,999 極具殺傷力的定價，在同級入門與中階市場中展現了強大的競爭優勢。

外觀工藝與智慧稱重系統

在外觀與結構設計上，機身採用沉穩百搭的深色金屬材質，並配備半透明黑色的雙層艙門，門封圈更導入了抗菌材料與自清潔功能。機艙內部貼心增設了 LED 照明燈，方便在昏暗環境下查看衣物。操作介面則由極簡的觸控面板取代實體按鍵，系統內建智慧稱重感應，能依據放入的衣物重量自動計算最合適的洗滌時間與行程，讓長輩或不熟悉設定的使用者也能一鍵輕鬆上手。

告別黏膩瑣碎：智慧自動投放洗劑技術

該機型另一大核心硬體亮點為中高階機種常見的自動洗劑投放系統。機身左上方的雙儲液槽可分別倒入洗衣精與柔軟精（或透過 App 切換為消毒液）。透過智慧稱重機制，系統會精準感應並自動抽取適量洗劑。更特別的是，機內配有專屬的獨立水劑混合模組，透過內部的 148 根柱狀通道將洗劑預先充分乳化起泡，再以高壓噴淋方式注入滾筒，顯著提升清潔效率並避免洗劑殘留。

直驅馬達與米家智慧生態的深度調控

針對洗淨效能，作者指出當前滾筒洗衣機的競爭核心在於水流、溫度與馬達演算法的整合調控。米家滾筒洗脫烘 Pro 仰賴 DD 馬達精準的高頻微擺與停動控制，模擬出手洗微摩擦、深層穿透與波紋漂洗等多種水流型態。使用者亦可串聯米家 App 解鎖超過 30 種專業洗滌模式，以智慧演算法徹底發揮硬體潛力，為現代家庭帶來高效、靜音且省心的洗烘體驗。

================================================

Right behind me is the first major home appliance brought to Taiwan by Xiaomi: the MIJIA Front-Load Washer Dryer Pro. Hi, welcome back, I'm Donkey. As the saying goes, for a harmonious household, you need the three major home appliance essentials. That includes an automatic dishwasher for your dishes, a robot vacuum for sweeping and mopping, and now Xiaomi brings the final piece: a washer-dryer to handle your laundry. That’s right, as Xiaomi’s first major. appliance to enter the Taiwan market, the MIJIA Front-Load Washer Dryer Pro has a very clear product positioning. The main highlight of this unit is that , on top of the standard wash and dry functions, it offers high-end peripheral specs far beyond its class. For instance, in terms of core hardware , Xiaomi uses a Direct Drive motor, which is highly popular but also more costly to produce. Its advantages are clear: compared to traditional solutions , a DD motor provides a quieter, more stable, and significantly more durable. user experience. And as a debut for Xiaomi's major appliances, they are confident enough to offer a 12-year warranty on this motor. However, savvy consumers know that besides the motor, we really need to look at the full machine warranty. Xiaomi is really going all out here, offering a two-year full-machine warranty right off the bat. For an appliance at this price point, that’s impressive. Beyond that, it also includes hardware usually found in mid-to-high-end models . For example, this machine features the automatic detergent dispensing function that everyone looks for when choosing a. washer. I must say, automatic dispensing is one of those features that, once you use it, you can never go back. Simply put, you used to have to measure and calculate exactly how much detergent to add every single time you did laundry. If you weren't careful, you’d spill a drop or two, and even if you switched to laundry pods, your hands would still feel sticky. Adding detergent is truly a tedious step , which is why I’ve always recommended prioritizing models that feature automatic dispensing. You just need to add your detergent and. fabric softener directly into their respective compartments. From then on, every time you do laundry, the machine will first weigh the clothes to sense how much detergent is needed. After weighing, it automatically draws the right amount, foams it up first to activate it, and then high-pressure sprays it onto the clothes; once you try it, you'll see how much better the experience is. On top of that, since it's a Xiaomi home appliance, this machine definitely comes with smart features. First, in terms of hardware, Xiaomi has hidden the physical.

buttons in favor of a smart screen design. As for the software, you can naturally connect it to the Mi Home app , unlocking more features directly via your phone and enabling advanced settings—a traditional strength of Xiaomi appliances. However, I think the real highlight for everyone is that besides providing better hardware and software, a superior 12-year motor warranty, and a two-year full-machine warranty, Xiaomi has priced it at an incredibly competitive 16,999. This price point makes it a formidable product for the entry-to-mid-range. market moving forward. While there might be competitors in this price bracket, there aren't many that offer this combination of hardware, warranty, and smart capabilities. In short, how does Xiaomi’s first Mi Home front-load washing machine Pro actually perform? Let's take a look together. Let’s start with the appearance; for this ID, Xiaomi opted for a conservative yet more versatile dark-colored body. In. terms of materials, the main structure on all four sides is made of metal. The front features a translucent black door design, with transparent glass on the inside and a translucent black plastic cover on the outside. Xiaomi has also incorporated a self-cleaning feature and antibacterial materials into the door seal, showing attention to small details . A pleasant surprise is that Xiaomi included an LED light. Although it's a minor touch, it makes things much easier when you're doing laundry on a balcony without lights, providing basic illumination. During operation, you can turn on the. LED to see inside through the door. Design-wise, Xiaomi went with the current mainstream square body, making it perfect for placement on a balcony or inside cabinetry. Because it uses a direct-drive motor, it is overall quieter and more stable. The only thing to note during installation is to ensure the technician levels it properly, and then avoid moving it afterward. Getting back to the most eye-catching part of the exterior, it’s definitely the clean touch panel strip on top. It’s simple to operate; just tap the power button to start, and you’ll see the Mi Home startup animation. From there, you can use the two up and down buttons below the screen to select different cleaning modes. Generally speaking, for regular clothes, you can just select "Smart Wash." The system will automatically detect and plan the cycle. If you want to fine-tune it, you can press "Next" on the right to adjust water temperature, number of rinse cycles, spin speed, and whether to include drying. Once finished, just press "Start" and.

the washing begins. Look at the Mijia Smart Front Load Washing Machine Pro, it starts by spinning empty for a moment when you turn it on. This step isn't a waste of time; it’s weighing the load to calculate the entire wash cycle. I’ll demonstrate here. For example, under identical settings, if I only put in one piece of clothing, the system detects it and finishes in about 30 minutes. But, for instance, if I load a full set of bedding and four pillowcases, you can see that after weighing, it changes to one hour and 16 minutes to complete,. which is the advantage of smart weighing ; the system automatically adjusts the cycle based on the load. For those who can never figure out how to set the washing machine, or for those buying one for elderly family members, having a smart mode is definitely much more convenient. Another major hardware highlight of the Mijia Smart Front Load Washing Machine Pro is the automatic detergent dispensing feature I just mentioned. When we pull out this drawer in the upper left, we can see there are two compartments in total. The one on the left is for detergent. My personal habit is to buy these refill packs and. pour them directly into the dispenser. The design of the refill pack is easier to pour, and it’s usually cheaper, making it perfect for household savings . Also, remember to choose a low-foam detergent suitable for front-load machines. The one on the right has two uses. First, you can add fabric softener . If you don't usually use fabric softener , you don't have to use the second compartment, or you can switch it to disinfectant; just toggle it via the app . If you use disinfectant, remember to check the instructions in the app. Once set, the system automatically determines how much detergent to add and when to dispense it during the weighing process. Oh, and by the way, if you want it more concentrated or less, you can also manually adjust the dispensing ratio in the app. If it runs out, the app will also send you a reminder. Actually, this machine is more than just simple automatic dispensing; what makes this Xiaomi model special is that if we take the machine apart, we can see it has an independent water and detergent mixing module. Inside the module, Xiaomi has added 148 column-shaped channels. So, when it adds detergent, it doesn't just spray it directly onto the clothes ; it fully mixes the detergent internally first to ensure it is highly effective. After mixing, it uses a high-pressure water jet to spray from the channel at the front of the drum. Having covered the exterior, let's move on to the most important hardware aspect of the front-load washer. First, in terms of hardware, the Mijia Smart Front-Load Washing Machine Pro uses a direct-drive motor, which is more expensive but significantly better. Its main advantages are that it is much more.

durable and offers higher power efficiency. Since it lacks the friction issues of traditional belt-driven systems, it is generally quieter, and direct-drive motors typically allow for more precise rotation control. For example, it enables high-frequency, small-angle back-and-forth rotation, as well as precise stopping. This brings us to the main point: for a 2024 front-load washing machine, getting clothes clean is already a very mature and basic requirement. So, what everyone is competing on now is how to more intelligently control water, temperature. , and the motor. For instance, among models with direct-drive motors, you will see many manufacturers highlighting their ability to perform various types of wash adjustments. Xiaomi, for example , lists their ability to simulate hand-washing with low-friction water flow, dissolve grime with high-penetration water flow, and reduce residue with wave-pattern rinsing; these are all effects achieved by combining smart water control with the motor. Therefore, the current battlefield for front-load washers is no longer just about cleaning; it is about integrating hardware and sensors with finely-tuned. algorithms to achieve delicate hardware control. As a smart home brand, they certainly have an inherent advantage, and all the features mentioned above are essentially built into the various wash modes when you actually use them. Taking Xiaomi as an example, you can unlock over 30 wash modes via the app; you simply choose the corresponding setting, and the system automatically applies the suitable water flow, temperature, and spin parameters. Overall, the direct-drive motor comes at a slightly higher cost, but it provides a relatively stable and much more precise drive solution. Moreover,. hardware tuning for components like off-axis suspensions has matured in recent years, which is ultimately why they dare to offer a 12-year motor warranty. Another interesting point is that everyone knows the mechanism of a drum washer relies on rotation, allowing clothes to drop and create a beating effect, which cleans away dirt through impact, water flow, and detergent. That is why Xiaomi has increased the drum diameter to 525mm this time; beyond providing more rotation space and centrifugal force, it also helps reduce. tangling. Now that we've covered the hardware, let’s move on to the actual testing phase. According to official specifications, the Mijia Smart Front-Load Washing Machine Pro offers a 12.5 kg washing capacity and an 8kg drying capacity. But if you've used a front-loader, you know the kilogram rating isn't very intuitive; it's mainly there so you can compare differences between models. In actual use, because the drum space is limited, a 10 to 12kg model is usually best for a small family of three to four .

The Mijia Smart Washing Machine Pro currently offers over 30 washing modes. From my experience, if you're just doing everyday laundry, you can just use the Smart Wash mode, and the system will automatically detect and set the cycle. I recommend going into the app and turning on the "AI usage habit recommendation" and "parameter memory" options. The system will then save your frequently used custom settings so you can quickly select them next time. I've also organized the other common modes for you, such as Quick Wash, Heavy Duty, Gentle, and Bulky. For high-temp sterilization or garment care needs, Xiaomi offers Air Wash, Fragrance Wash, High-Temp Wash, and Sterilization Wash. I find the Sterilization Wash to be a particularly special feature of this machine. In this mode, the system starts the cycle by activating 90 ° C high-temperature steam , which, according to the official specs , achieves 99.99%sterilization and 99.99 %virus removal, along with odor elimination. After the high-temperature steam phase, it proceeds with a wash using hot water. . If you have children, pets, or sensitive skin, the Sterilization Wash is a great choice. The Fragrance Wash is also quite interesting, perfect for when your clothes smell like hot pot. The system uses low-temperature steam and adds a small amount of detergent to refresh the fabric. Xiaomi's custom features are very rich; for example, when you select Sterilization Wash in the app. You can further customize the soak time, and the water temperature can be set to 40, 60, or a maximum of 80 degrees. The rinse count can be adjusted up to 5. times. The spin speed can reach a maximum of 1400 RPM. You can also choose whether to enable drying, with three levels available: " Iron" for slightly damp clothes, " Ready-to-Wear" for immediate use after drying, and "Storage" for bone-dry clothes you can put away right after the cycle. Another feature I really like is that this Xiaomi model supports an anti-wrinkle and freshness mode. Simply put, sometimes you finish a load but aren't home, which could otherwise lead. to wrinkled clothes. Once this feature is enabled, if you haven't taken the clothes out 30 minutes after the cycle ends, the drum will rotate to keep them airy. Also, in smart mode, you can add a steam care cycle. Beyond that, Xiaomi covers various common special needs, such as baby clothes, lingerie, new clothes, curtains , large items, sportswear, and performance gear.

For specific fabric types, Xiaomi also provides dedicated cycles like cotton/ linen, wool, down, synthetic, and silk. It is important to note that since this is a water-cooled drying model, I generally recommend only washing these special materials rather than drying them. Fortunately, Xiaomi has included a thoughtful safety mechanism in both the app and the cycle settings. For instance , if you select the wool mode, it only washes and doesn't offer a drying option , so you won't accidentally overlook it . By the way, if you're in a rush, there’s. a quick wash mode. Keep the load small—about one t-shirt, one pair of pants, and a pair of socks, roughly one to two kilograms—and the system will finish in 12 minutes. Now, let’s test the feature everyone cares about most: the drying function. As mentioned earlier, judging by Xiaomi's pricing, it's clear the Mijia Smart Washing Machine Pro is one of the most mainstream and relatively affordable water-cooled drying models available. Taking the machine apart, we can see the. Mijia Smart Washing Machine Pro is indeed a standard water-cooled dryer. Xiaomi uses a stainless steel exhaust pipe to prevent bacterial growth and minimize lint buildup. The principle behind water-cooled drying is actually quite easy to understand. We’ve shared an animation about it before, so let’s review it here. Water-cooled drying works by first heating the air with a module at the top of the machine, then blowing it into the drum. This raises the internal temperature,. turning the moisture in the clothes into steam and gradually removing it. This is where the magic happens. By injecting cold water to keep the cooling module at a low temperature, the high-temperature steam condenses back into water. Then, we take the opportunity to drain this condensed water away through the pipes. This allows us to gradually dry the clothes; the principle is very simple. I think you’ve all seen it now. So, overall, the biggest feature of the condenser drying method is its relatively simple principle and. straightforward structure, which is the main reason why every brand can produce a popular washer-dryer combo. However, it must be clarified that the drying temperature during the condenser process is relatively high. Using it for regular quilts, bedsheets, clothes, T-shirts, and pants is generally not a problem. Just be mindful of T-shirts with prints ; it’s recommended to turn them inside out or use a laundry bag, and unfold them immediately after drying. The most important point is to follow the laundry label instructions; never force-dry items, as it may lead to shrinkage or fiber damage.

It is worth mentioning that this Xiaomi model has built-in high-precision sensors, which is how it achieves intelligent drying. This means the system automatically controls the temperature, time, and humidity to achieve the three drying levels mentioned earlier, while keeping the temperature rise within a reasonable range throughout the process. Next, let's move on to a thorough drying test. We used our small family's two to three days 'worth of laundry, including two hoodies, four T-shirts, four pairs of shorts, two pairs of long pants, six. pairs of socks, and two jackets, then selected the "ready-to-wear" smart drying mode to let the system automatically determine the duration. We press start. Okay, the drying is finished. Through our tests, the entire load of laundry weighed about 4.25 kilograms before drying. After drying, it dropped to 4.2 kilograms. Since clothes are naturally absorbent, it is perfectly normal for them to be lighter than before drying, confirming that it can indeed achieve thorough drying. As for power consumption, a single drying cycle. measured by our external instrument used only about 1.77 kWh of electricity. At an average cost of 5 yuan per kWh, the electricity cost is only about 8 to 9 yuan. A reminder: if there is a notification for an update, remember to update so the system can display more accurate power consumption data. The drying result in "ready-to-wear" mode is quite sufficient. If taken out immediately like we did, the clothes might feel a bit damp, but it's within a reasonable range. If you are washing while away from home, remember to turn on the light-tumble function, which will yield better results. If you care more about smoothness, you can choose the ironing mode to iron them briefly before putting them away. We also tested a set of double-sized bedding along with four pillowcases; it was basically 80%full when stuffed in, serving as a bit of a stress test. Before washing, the set weighed 1.8 kg, and after drying, it returned to 1.75 kg , so it was indeed dried. Power consumption was 1.091 kWh; at 5 dollars per kWh, that’s about 5 dollars per cycle. Next is spin-cycle noise control . Using the same duvet cover and. pillowcases, we measured at 1400 RPM from one meter away. The peak noise was around 57 decibels, so the motor's noise control is quite good. By the way, if you want it to be quieter when washing at night, you can enable an additional mode. The app has a noise-reduction spin feature, but it's actually quite quiet even without it. Let's take a quick look at the app. If you want to control the washer via the app, for safety reasons, remember to enable remote control mode before.

starting every cycle. The door will then lock automatically to prevent children or pets from getting inside. On the app interface, Xiaomi helpfully displays your total power and water consumption at the top, allowing you to quickly check the status. In the mode section, there are over 30 modes as previously mentioned. You can tap into each one for a brief description to help you choose, or adjust further options. Next, you can select the detergent dispensing method and ratio here. If you. want to switch to laundry pod mode, you can adjust it here as well. If you want to change the 14 default modes on the machine, you can customize them in the cloud settings. For instance, if you don't need a delicate wash, you can swap in a down jacket wash instead. The AI usage habit feature was already introduced; remember to turn it on. The laundry history is quite interesting . Besides recording the mode and start time, you can tap in to see settings like soaking, temperature, and spin speed, making it very easy to review. By the way, the Mijia washer-dryer also supports OTA updates, so if new features are released in the future, the manufacturer can push them to your machine. Finally, regarding maintenance, a major advantage of these new Xiaomi models is automatic rinsing. Older models often failed to dry properly because lint would accumulate inside. This Xiaomi model automatically maintains the drum and fan ducts during each cycle to prevent dirt from drying and building up. At the same time, Xiaomi added a. dedicated water channel to rinse the door, preventing foam residue. So with normal use, just periodically run the drum self-clean cycle and open the filter compartment at the bottom right to clear out the lint. Alright, that's it for this episode. We’ve covered the most comprehensive hands-on testing in this video, so if you have any questions, feel free to discuss them below. I’m Donkey. We’ll see you next time. If you enjoyed this episode, don't forget to subscribe to Bunny and turn on the notifications to get our latest review updates. Of course, you can also find us on Facebook. at "Bunny Assistant," Instagram, and Line. If you have any other questions, don't forget to leave a comment below, and we’ll see you in the next video.

值得閱讀的理由

  • 掌握小米首款登台大型家電「米家滾筒洗脫烘 Pro」的核心規格、市場定位與極具競爭力的性價比優勢。
  • 深入了解直驅變頻馬達（DD 馬達）與智慧雙槽自動洗劑投放系統如何大幅提升洗衣品質與日常便利性。
  • 全面解析智慧稱重、APP 遠端控制以及超過 30 種洗滌模式等智慧家庭生態鏈帶來的全方位升級體驗。

摘要

小米首款大型家電登場：極致性價比與超長保固

作者介紹了小米正式進軍台灣大型家電市場的首款代表作——米家滾筒洗脫烘 Pro。這款產品主打「越級」的高規格配置，核心採用成本較高但運作更安靜、更穩定的直驅變頻馬達（DD 馬達）。為了展現對產品質量的信心，小米祭出了長達 12 年馬達保固以及 2 年全機保固，再搭配 NT$16,999 極具殺傷力的定價，在同級入門與中階市場中展現了強大的競爭優勢。

外觀工藝與智慧稱重系統

在外觀與結構設計上，機身採用沉穩百搭的深色金屬材質，並配備半透明黑色的雙層艙門，門封圈更導入了抗菌材料與自清潔功能。機艙內部貼心增設了 LED 照明燈，方便在昏暗環境下查看衣物。操作介面則由極簡的觸控面板取代實體按鍵，系統內建智慧稱重感應，能依據放入的衣物重量自動計算最合適的洗滌時間與行程，讓長輩或不熟悉設定的使用者也能一鍵輕鬆上手。

告別黏膩瑣碎：智慧自動投放洗劑技術

該機型另一大核心硬體亮點為中高階機種常見的自動洗劑投放系統。機身左上方的雙儲液槽可分別倒入洗衣精與柔軟精（或透過 App 切換為消毒液）。透過智慧稱重機制，系統會精準感應並自動抽取適量洗劑。更特別的是，機內配有專屬的獨立水劑混合模組，透過內部的 148 根柱狀通道將洗劑預先充分乳化起泡，再以高壓噴淋方式注入滾筒，顯著提升清潔效率並避免洗劑殘留。

直驅馬達與米家智慧生態的深度調控

針對洗淨效能，作者指出當前滾筒洗衣機的競爭核心在於水流、溫度與馬達演算法的整合調控。米家滾筒洗脫烘 Pro 仰賴 DD 馬達精準的高頻微擺與停動控制，模擬出手洗微摩擦、深層穿透與波紋漂洗等多種水流型態。使用者亦可串聯米家 App 解鎖超過 30 種專業洗滌模式，以智慧演算法徹底發揮硬體潛力，為現代家庭帶來高效、靜音且省心的洗烘體驗。

================================================

Right behind me is the first major home appliance brought to Taiwan by Xiaomi: the MIJIA Front-Load Washer Dryer Pro. Hi, welcome back, I'm Donkey. As the saying goes, for a harmonious household, you need the three major home appliance essentials. That includes an automatic dishwasher for your dishes, a robot vacuum for sweeping and mopping, and now Xiaomi brings the final piece: a washer-dryer to handle your laundry. That’s right, as Xiaomi’s first major. appliance to enter the Taiwan market, the MIJIA Front-Load Washer Dryer Pro has a very clear product positioning. The main highlight of this unit is that , on top of the standard wash and dry functions, it offers high-end peripheral specs far beyond its class. For instance, in terms of core hardware , Xiaomi uses a Direct Drive motor, which is highly popular but also more costly to produce. Its advantages are clear: compared to traditional solutions , a DD motor provides a quieter, more stable, and significantly more durable. user experience. And as a debut for Xiaomi's major appliances, they are confident enough to offer a 12-year warranty on this motor. However, savvy consumers know that besides the motor, we really need to look at the full machine warranty. Xiaomi is really going all out here, offering a two-year full-machine warranty right off the bat. For an appliance at this price point, that’s impressive. Beyond that, it also includes hardware usually found in mid-to-high-end models . For example, this machine features the automatic detergent dispensing function that everyone looks for when choosing a. washer. I must say, automatic dispensing is one of those features that, once you use it, you can never go back. Simply put, you used to have to measure and calculate exactly how much detergent to add every single time you did laundry. If you weren't careful, you’d spill a drop or two, and even if you switched to laundry pods, your hands would still feel sticky. Adding detergent is truly a tedious step , which is why I’ve always recommended prioritizing models that feature automatic dispensing. You just need to add your detergent and. fabric softener directly into their respective compartments. From then on, every time you do laundry, the machine will first weigh the clothes to sense how much detergent is needed. After weighing, it automatically draws the right amount, foams it up first to activate it, and then high-pressure sprays it onto the clothes; once you try it, you'll see how much better the experience is. On top of that, since it's a Xiaomi home appliance, this machine definitely comes with smart features. First, in terms of hardware, Xiaomi has hidden the physical.

buttons in favor of a smart screen design. As for the software, you can naturally connect it to the Mi Home app , unlocking more features directly via your phone and enabling advanced settings—a traditional strength of Xiaomi appliances. However, I think the real highlight for everyone is that besides providing better hardware and software, a superior 12-year motor warranty, and a two-year full-machine warranty, Xiaomi has priced it at an incredibly competitive 16,999. This price point makes it a formidable product for the entry-to-mid-range. market moving forward. While there might be competitors in this price bracket, there aren't many that offer this combination of hardware, warranty, and smart capabilities. In short, how does Xiaomi’s first Mi Home front-load washing machine Pro actually perform? Let's take a look together. Let’s start with the appearance; for this ID, Xiaomi opted for a conservative yet more versatile dark-colored body. In. terms of materials, the main structure on all four sides is made of metal. The front features a translucent black door design, with transparent glass on the inside and a translucent black plastic cover on the outside. Xiaomi has also incorporated a self-cleaning feature and antibacterial materials into the door seal, showing attention to small details . A pleasant surprise is that Xiaomi included an LED light. Although it's a minor touch, it makes things much easier when you're doing laundry on a balcony without lights, providing basic illumination. During operation, you can turn on the. LED to see inside through the door. Design-wise, Xiaomi went with the current mainstream square body, making it perfect for placement on a balcony or inside cabinetry. Because it uses a direct-drive motor, it is overall quieter and more stable. The only thing to note during installation is to ensure the technician levels it properly, and then avoid moving it afterward. Getting back to the most eye-catching part of the exterior, it’s definitely the clean touch panel strip on top. It’s simple to operate; just tap the power button to start, and you’ll see the Mi Home startup animation. From there, you can use the two up and down buttons below the screen to select different cleaning modes. Generally speaking, for regular clothes, you can just select "Smart Wash." The system will automatically detect and plan the cycle. If you want to fine-tune it, you can press "Next" on the right to adjust water temperature, number of rinse cycles, spin speed, and whether to include drying. Once finished, just press "Start" and.

the washing begins. Look at the Mijia Smart Front Load Washing Machine Pro, it starts by spinning empty for a moment when you turn it on. This step isn't a waste of time; it’s weighing the load to calculate the entire wash cycle. I’ll demonstrate here. For example, under identical settings, if I only put in one piece of clothing, the system detects it and finishes in about 30 minutes. But, for instance, if I load a full set of bedding and four pillowcases, you can see that after weighing, it changes to one hour and 16 minutes to complete,. which is the advantage of smart weighing ; the system automatically adjusts the cycle based on the load. For those who can never figure out how to set the washing machine, or for those buying one for elderly family members, having a smart mode is definitely much more convenient. Another major hardware highlight of the Mijia Smart Front Load Washing Machine Pro is the automatic detergent dispensing feature I just mentioned. When we pull out this drawer in the upper left, we can see there are two compartments in total. The one on the left is for detergent. My personal habit is to buy these refill packs and. pour them directly into the dispenser. The design of the refill pack is easier to pour, and it’s usually cheaper, making it perfect for household savings . Also, remember to choose a low-foam detergent suitable for front-load machines. The one on the right has two uses. First, you can add fabric softener . If you don't usually use fabric softener , you don't have to use the second compartment, or you can switch it to disinfectant; just toggle it via the app . If you use disinfectant, remember to check the instructions in the app. Once set, the system automatically determines how much detergent to add and when to dispense it during the weighing process. Oh, and by the way, if you want it more concentrated or less, you can also manually adjust the dispensing ratio in the app. If it runs out, the app will also send you a reminder. Actually, this machine is more than just simple automatic dispensing; what makes this Xiaomi model special is that if we take the machine apart, we can see it has an independent water and detergent mixing module. Inside the module, Xiaomi has added 148 column-shaped channels. So, when it adds detergent, it doesn't just spray it directly onto the clothes ; it fully mixes the detergent internally first to ensure it is highly effective. After mixing, it uses a high-pressure water jet to spray from the channel at the front of the drum. Having covered the exterior, let's move on to the most important hardware aspect of the front-load washer. First, in terms of hardware, the Mijia Smart Front-Load Washing Machine Pro uses a direct-drive motor, which is more expensive but significantly better. Its main advantages are that it is much more.

durable and offers higher power efficiency. Since it lacks the friction issues of traditional belt-driven systems, it is generally quieter, and direct-drive motors typically allow for more precise rotation control. For example, it enables high-frequency, small-angle back-and-forth rotation, as well as precise stopping. This brings us to the main point: for a 2024 front-load washing machine, getting clothes clean is already a very mature and basic requirement. So, what everyone is competing on now is how to more intelligently control water, temperature. , and the motor. For instance, among models with direct-drive motors, you will see many manufacturers highlighting their ability to perform various types of wash adjustments. Xiaomi, for example , lists their ability to simulate hand-washing with low-friction water flow, dissolve grime with high-penetration water flow, and reduce residue with wave-pattern rinsing; these are all effects achieved by combining smart water control with the motor. Therefore, the current battlefield for front-load washers is no longer just about cleaning; it is about integrating hardware and sensors with finely-tuned. algorithms to achieve delicate hardware control. As a smart home brand, they certainly have an inherent advantage, and all the features mentioned above are essentially built into the various wash modes when you actually use them. Taking Xiaomi as an example, you can unlock over 30 wash modes via the app; you simply choose the corresponding setting, and the system automatically applies the suitable water flow, temperature, and spin parameters. Overall, the direct-drive motor comes at a slightly higher cost, but it provides a relatively stable and much more precise drive solution. Moreover,. hardware tuning for components like off-axis suspensions has matured in recent years, which is ultimately why they dare to offer a 12-year motor warranty. Another interesting point is that everyone knows the mechanism of a drum washer relies on rotation, allowing clothes to drop and create a beating effect, which cleans away dirt through impact, water flow, and detergent. That is why Xiaomi has increased the drum diameter to 525mm this time; beyond providing more rotation space and centrifugal force, it also helps reduce. tangling. Now that we've covered the hardware, let’s move on to the actual testing phase. According to official specifications, the Mijia Smart Front-Load Washing Machine Pro offers a 12.5 kg washing capacity and an 8kg drying capacity. But if you've used a front-loader, you know the kilogram rating isn't very intuitive; it's mainly there so you can compare differences between models. In actual use, because the drum space is limited, a 10 to 12kg model is usually best for a small family of three to four .

The Mijia Smart Washing Machine Pro currently offers over 30 washing modes. From my experience, if you're just doing everyday laundry, you can just use the Smart Wash mode, and the system will automatically detect and set the cycle. I recommend going into the app and turning on the "AI usage habit recommendation" and "parameter memory" options. The system will then save your frequently used custom settings so you can quickly select them next time. I've also organized the other common modes for you, such as Quick Wash, Heavy Duty, Gentle, and Bulky. For high-temp sterilization or garment care needs, Xiaomi offers Air Wash, Fragrance Wash, High-Temp Wash, and Sterilization Wash. I find the Sterilization Wash to be a particularly special feature of this machine. In this mode, the system starts the cycle by activating 90 ° C high-temperature steam , which, according to the official specs , achieves 99.99%sterilization and 99.99 %virus removal, along with odor elimination. After the high-temperature steam phase, it proceeds with a wash using hot water. . If you have children, pets, or sensitive skin, the Sterilization Wash is a great choice. The Fragrance Wash is also quite interesting, perfect for when your clothes smell like hot pot. The system uses low-temperature steam and adds a small amount of detergent to refresh the fabric. Xiaomi's custom features are very rich; for example, when you select Sterilization Wash in the app. You can further customize the soak time, and the water temperature can be set to 40, 60, or a maximum of 80 degrees. The rinse count can be adjusted up to 5. times. The spin speed can reach a maximum of 1400 RPM. You can also choose whether to enable drying, with three levels available: " Iron" for slightly damp clothes, " Ready-to-Wear" for immediate use after drying, and "Storage" for bone-dry clothes you can put away right after the cycle. Another feature I really like is that this Xiaomi model supports an anti-wrinkle and freshness mode. Simply put, sometimes you finish a load but aren't home, which could otherwise lead. to wrinkled clothes. Once this feature is enabled, if you haven't taken the clothes out 30 minutes after the cycle ends, the drum will rotate to keep them airy. Also, in smart mode, you can add a steam care cycle. Beyond that, Xiaomi covers various common special needs, such as baby clothes, lingerie, new clothes, curtains , large items, sportswear, and performance gear.

For specific fabric types, Xiaomi also provides dedicated cycles like cotton/ linen, wool, down, synthetic, and silk. It is important to note that since this is a water-cooled drying model, I generally recommend only washing these special materials rather than drying them. Fortunately, Xiaomi has included a thoughtful safety mechanism in both the app and the cycle settings. For instance , if you select the wool mode, it only washes and doesn't offer a drying option , so you won't accidentally overlook it . By the way, if you're in a rush, there’s. a quick wash mode. Keep the load small—about one t-shirt, one pair of pants, and a pair of socks, roughly one to two kilograms—and the system will finish in 12 minutes. Now, let’s test the feature everyone cares about most: the drying function. As mentioned earlier, judging by Xiaomi's pricing, it's clear the Mijia Smart Washing Machine Pro is one of the most mainstream and relatively affordable water-cooled drying models available. Taking the machine apart, we can see the. Mijia Smart Washing Machine Pro is indeed a standard water-cooled dryer. Xiaomi uses a stainless steel exhaust pipe to prevent bacterial growth and minimize lint buildup. The principle behind water-cooled drying is actually quite easy to understand. We’ve shared an animation about it before, so let’s review it here. Water-cooled drying works by first heating the air with a module at the top of the machine, then blowing it into the drum. This raises the internal temperature,. turning the moisture in the clothes into steam and gradually removing it. This is where the magic happens. By injecting cold water to keep the cooling module at a low temperature, the high-temperature steam condenses back into water. Then, we take the opportunity to drain this condensed water away through the pipes. This allows us to gradually dry the clothes; the principle is very simple. I think you’ve all seen it now. So, overall, the biggest feature of the condenser drying method is its relatively simple principle and. straightforward structure, which is the main reason why every brand can produce a popular washer-dryer combo. However, it must be clarified that the drying temperature during the condenser process is relatively high. Using it for regular quilts, bedsheets, clothes, T-shirts, and pants is generally not a problem. Just be mindful of T-shirts with prints ; it’s recommended to turn them inside out or use a laundry bag, and unfold them immediately after drying. The most important point is to follow the laundry label instructions; never force-dry items, as it may lead to shrinkage or fiber damage.

It is worth mentioning that this Xiaomi model has built-in high-precision sensors, which is how it achieves intelligent drying. This means the system automatically controls the temperature, time, and humidity to achieve the three drying levels mentioned earlier, while keeping the temperature rise within a reasonable range throughout the process. Next, let's move on to a thorough drying test. We used our small family's two to three days 'worth of laundry, including two hoodies, four T-shirts, four pairs of shorts, two pairs of long pants, six. pairs of socks, and two jackets, then selected the "ready-to-wear" smart drying mode to let the system automatically determine the duration. We press start. Okay, the drying is finished. Through our tests, the entire load of laundry weighed about 4.25 kilograms before drying. After drying, it dropped to 4.2 kilograms. Since clothes are naturally absorbent, it is perfectly normal for them to be lighter than before drying, confirming that it can indeed achieve thorough drying. As for power consumption, a single drying cycle. measured by our external instrument used only about 1.77 kWh of electricity. At an average cost of 5 yuan per kWh, the electricity cost is only about 8 to 9 yuan. A reminder: if there is a notification for an update, remember to update so the system can display more accurate power consumption data. The drying result in "ready-to-wear" mode is quite sufficient. If taken out immediately like we did, the clothes might feel a bit damp, but it's within a reasonable range. If you are washing while away from home, remember to turn on the light-tumble function, which will yield better results. If you care more about smoothness, you can choose the ironing mode to iron them briefly before putting them away. We also tested a set of double-sized bedding along with four pillowcases; it was basically 80%full when stuffed in, serving as a bit of a stress test. Before washing, the set weighed 1.8 kg, and after drying, it returned to 1.75 kg , so it was indeed dried. Power consumption was 1.091 kWh; at 5 dollars per kWh, that’s about 5 dollars per cycle. Next is spin-cycle noise control . Using the same duvet cover and. pillowcases, we measured at 1400 RPM from one meter away. The peak noise was around 57 decibels, so the motor's noise control is quite good. By the way, if you want it to be quieter when washing at night, you can enable an additional mode. The app has a noise-reduction spin feature, but it's actually quite quiet even without it. Let's take a quick look at the app. If you want to control the washer via the app, for safety reasons, remember to enable remote control mode before.

starting every cycle. The door will then lock automatically to prevent children or pets from getting inside. On the app interface, Xiaomi helpfully displays your total power and water consumption at the top, allowing you to quickly check the status. In the mode section, there are over 30 modes as previously mentioned. You can tap into each one for a brief description to help you choose, or adjust further options. Next, you can select the detergent dispensing method and ratio here. If you. want to switch to laundry pod mode, you can adjust it here as well. If you want to change the 14 default modes on the machine, you can customize them in the cloud settings. For instance, if you don't need a delicate wash, you can swap in a down jacket wash instead. The AI usage habit feature was already introduced; remember to turn it on. The laundry history is quite interesting . Besides recording the mode and start time, you can tap in to see settings like soaking, temperature, and spin speed, making it very easy to review. By the way, the Mijia washer-dryer also supports OTA updates, so if new features are released in the future, the manufacturer can push them to your machine. Finally, regarding maintenance, a major advantage of these new Xiaomi models is automatic rinsing. Older models often failed to dry properly because lint would accumulate inside. This Xiaomi model automatically maintains the drum and fan ducts during each cycle to prevent dirt from drying and building up. At the same time, Xiaomi added a. dedicated water channel to rinse the door, preventing foam residue. So with normal use, just periodically run the drum self-clean cycle and open the filter compartment at the bottom right to clear out the lint. Alright, that's it for this episode. We’ve covered the most comprehensive hands-on testing in this video, so if you have any questions, feel free to discuss them below. I’m Donkey. We’ll see you next time. If you enjoyed this episode, don't forget to subscribe to Bunny and turn on the notifications to get our latest review updates. Of course, you can also find us on Facebook. at "Bunny Assistant," Instagram, and Line. If you have any other questions, don't forget to leave a comment below, and we’ll see you in the next video.

item.content:encoded:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u_M7IUHMXKk

值得閱讀的理由

  • 掌握小米首款登台大型家電「米家滾筒洗脫烘 Pro」的核心規格、市場定位與極具競爭力的性價比優勢。
  • 深入了解直驅變頻馬達（DD 馬達）與智慧雙槽自動洗劑投放系統如何大幅提升洗衣品質與日常便利性。
  • 全面解析智慧稱重、APP 遠端控制以及超過 30 種洗滌模式等智慧家庭生態鏈帶來的全方位升級體驗。

摘要

小米首款大型家電登場：極致性價比與超長保固

作者介紹了小米正式進軍台灣大型家電市場的首款代表作——米家滾筒洗脫烘 Pro。這款產品主打「越級」的高規格配置，核心採用成本較高但運作更安靜、更穩定的直驅變頻馬達（DD 馬達）。為了展現對產品質量的信心，小米祭出了長達 12 年馬達保固以及 2 年全機保固，再搭配 NT$16,999 極具殺傷力的定價，在同級入門與中階市場中展現了強大的競爭優勢。

外觀工藝與智慧稱重系統

在外觀與結構設計上，機身採用沉穩百搭的深色金屬材質，並配備半透明黑色的雙層艙門，門封圈更導入了抗菌材料與自清潔功能。機艙內部貼心增設了 LED 照明燈，方便在昏暗環境下查看衣物。操作介面則由極簡的觸控面板取代實體按鍵，系統內建智慧稱重感應，能依據放入的衣物重量自動計算最合適的洗滌時間與行程，讓長輩或不熟悉設定的使用者也能一鍵輕鬆上手。

告別黏膩瑣碎：智慧自動投放洗劑技術

該機型另一大核心硬體亮點為中高階機種常見的自動洗劑投放系統。機身左上方的雙儲液槽可分別倒入洗衣精與柔軟精（或透過 App 切換為消毒液）。透過智慧稱重機制，系統會精準感應並自動抽取適量洗劑。更特別的是，機內配有專屬的獨立水劑混合模組，透過內部的 148 根柱狀通道將洗劑預先充分乳化起泡，再以高壓噴淋方式注入滾筒，顯著提升清潔效率並避免洗劑殘留。

直驅馬達與米家智慧生態的深度調控

針對洗淨效能，作者指出當前滾筒洗衣機的競爭核心在於水流、溫度與馬達演算法的整合調控。米家滾筒洗脫烘 Pro 仰賴 DD 馬達精準的高頻微擺與停動控制，模擬出手洗微摩擦、深層穿透與波紋漂洗等多種水流型態。使用者亦可串聯米家 App 解鎖超過 30 種專業洗滌模式，以智慧演算法徹底發揮硬體潛力，為現代家庭帶來高效、靜音且省心的洗烘體驗。

================================================

Right behind me is the first major home appliance brought to Taiwan by Xiaomi: the MIJIA Front-Load Washer Dryer Pro. Hi, welcome back, I'm Donkey. As the saying goes, for a harmonious household, you need the three major home appliance essentials. That includes an automatic dishwasher for your dishes, a robot vacuum for sweeping and mopping, and now Xiaomi brings the final piece: a washer-dryer to handle your laundry. That’s right, as Xiaomi’s first major. appliance to enter the Taiwan market, the MIJIA Front-Load Washer Dryer Pro has a very clear product positioning. The main highlight of this unit is that , on top of the standard wash and dry functions, it offers high-end peripheral specs far beyond its class. For instance, in terms of core hardware , Xiaomi uses a Direct Drive motor, which is highly popular but also more costly to produce. Its advantages are clear: compared to traditional solutions , a DD motor provides a quieter, more stable, and significantly more durable. user experience. And as a debut for Xiaomi's major appliances, they are confident enough to offer a 12-year warranty on this motor. However, savvy consumers know that besides the motor, we really need to look at the full machine warranty. Xiaomi is really going all out here, offering a two-year full-machine warranty right off the bat. For an appliance at this price point, that’s impressive. Beyond that, it also includes hardware usually found in mid-to-high-end models . For example, this machine features the automatic detergent dispensing function that everyone looks for when choosing a. washer. I must say, automatic dispensing is one of those features that, once you use it, you can never go back. Simply put, you used to have to measure and calculate exactly how much detergent to add every single time you did laundry. If you weren't careful, you’d spill a drop or two, and even if you switched to laundry pods, your hands would still feel sticky. Adding detergent is truly a tedious step , which is why I’ve always recommended prioritizing models that feature automatic dispensing. You just need to add your detergent and. fabric softener directly into their respective compartments. From then on, every time you do laundry, the machine will first weigh the clothes to sense how much detergent is needed. After weighing, it automatically draws the right amount, foams it up first to activate it, and then high-pressure sprays it onto the clothes; once you try it, you'll see how much better the experience is. On top of that, since it's a Xiaomi home appliance, this machine definitely comes with smart features. First, in terms of hardware, Xiaomi has hidden the physical.

buttons in favor of a smart screen design. As for the software, you can naturally connect it to the Mi Home app , unlocking more features directly via your phone and enabling advanced settings—a traditional strength of Xiaomi appliances. However, I think the real highlight for everyone is that besides providing better hardware and software, a superior 12-year motor warranty, and a two-year full-machine warranty, Xiaomi has priced it at an incredibly competitive 16,999. This price point makes it a formidable product for the entry-to-mid-range. market moving forward. While there might be competitors in this price bracket, there aren't many that offer this combination of hardware, warranty, and smart capabilities. In short, how does Xiaomi’s first Mi Home front-load washing machine Pro actually perform? Let's take a look together. Let’s start with the appearance; for this ID, Xiaomi opted for a conservative yet more versatile dark-colored body. In. terms of materials, the main structure on all four sides is made of metal. The front features a translucent black door design, with transparent glass on the inside and a translucent black plastic cover on the outside. Xiaomi has also incorporated a self-cleaning feature and antibacterial materials into the door seal, showing attention to small details . A pleasant surprise is that Xiaomi included an LED light. Although it's a minor touch, it makes things much easier when you're doing laundry on a balcony without lights, providing basic illumination. During operation, you can turn on the. LED to see inside through the door. Design-wise, Xiaomi went with the current mainstream square body, making it perfect for placement on a balcony or inside cabinetry. Because it uses a direct-drive motor, it is overall quieter and more stable. The only thing to note during installation is to ensure the technician levels it properly, and then avoid moving it afterward. Getting back to the most eye-catching part of the exterior, it’s definitely the clean touch panel strip on top. It’s simple to operate; just tap the power button to start, and you’ll see the Mi Home startup animation. From there, you can use the two up and down buttons below the screen to select different cleaning modes. Generally speaking, for regular clothes, you can just select "Smart Wash." The system will automatically detect and plan the cycle. If you want to fine-tune it, you can press "Next" on the right to adjust water temperature, number of rinse cycles, spin speed, and whether to include drying. Once finished, just press "Start" and.

the washing begins. Look at the Mijia Smart Front Load Washing Machine Pro, it starts by spinning empty for a moment when you turn it on. This step isn't a waste of time; it’s weighing the load to calculate the entire wash cycle. I’ll demonstrate here. For example, under identical settings, if I only put in one piece of clothing, the system detects it and finishes in about 30 minutes. But, for instance, if I load a full set of bedding and four pillowcases, you can see that after weighing, it changes to one hour and 16 minutes to complete,. which is the advantage of smart weighing ; the system automatically adjusts the cycle based on the load. For those who can never figure out how to set the washing machine, or for those buying one for elderly family members, having a smart mode is definitely much more convenient. Another major hardware highlight of the Mijia Smart Front Load Washing Machine Pro is the automatic detergent dispensing feature I just mentioned. When we pull out this drawer in the upper left, we can see there are two compartments in total. The one on the left is for detergent. My personal habit is to buy these refill packs and. pour them directly into the dispenser. The design of the refill pack is easier to pour, and it’s usually cheaper, making it perfect for household savings . Also, remember to choose a low-foam detergent suitable for front-load machines. The one on the right has two uses. First, you can add fabric softener . If you don't usually use fabric softener , you don't have to use the second compartment, or you can switch it to disinfectant; just toggle it via the app . If you use disinfectant, remember to check the instructions in the app. Once set, the system automatically determines how much detergent to add and when to dispense it during the weighing process. Oh, and by the way, if you want it more concentrated or less, you can also manually adjust the dispensing ratio in the app. If it runs out, the app will also send you a reminder. Actually, this machine is more than just simple automatic dispensing; what makes this Xiaomi model special is that if we take the machine apart, we can see it has an independent water and detergent mixing module. Inside the module, Xiaomi has added 148 column-shaped channels. So, when it adds detergent, it doesn't just spray it directly onto the clothes ; it fully mixes the detergent internally first to ensure it is highly effective. After mixing, it uses a high-pressure water jet to spray from the channel at the front of the drum. Having covered the exterior, let's move on to the most important hardware aspect of the front-load washer. First, in terms of hardware, the Mijia Smart Front-Load Washing Machine Pro uses a direct-drive motor, which is more expensive but significantly better. Its main advantages are that it is much more.

durable and offers higher power efficiency. Since it lacks the friction issues of traditional belt-driven systems, it is generally quieter, and direct-drive motors typically allow for more precise rotation control. For example, it enables high-frequency, small-angle back-and-forth rotation, as well as precise stopping. This brings us to the main point: for a 2024 front-load washing machine, getting clothes clean is already a very mature and basic requirement. So, what everyone is competing on now is how to more intelligently control water, temperature. , and the motor. For instance, among models with direct-drive motors, you will see many manufacturers highlighting their ability to perform various types of wash adjustments. Xiaomi, for example , lists their ability to simulate hand-washing with low-friction water flow, dissolve grime with high-penetration water flow, and reduce residue with wave-pattern rinsing; these are all effects achieved by combining smart water control with the motor. Therefore, the current battlefield for front-load washers is no longer just about cleaning; it is about integrating hardware and sensors with finely-tuned. algorithms to achieve delicate hardware control. As a smart home brand, they certainly have an inherent advantage, and all the features mentioned above are essentially built into the various wash modes when you actually use them. Taking Xiaomi as an example, you can unlock over 30 wash modes via the app; you simply choose the corresponding setting, and the system automatically applies the suitable water flow, temperature, and spin parameters. Overall, the direct-drive motor comes at a slightly higher cost, but it provides a relatively stable and much more precise drive solution. Moreover,. hardware tuning for components like off-axis suspensions has matured in recent years, which is ultimately why they dare to offer a 12-year motor warranty. Another interesting point is that everyone knows the mechanism of a drum washer relies on rotation, allowing clothes to drop and create a beating effect, which cleans away dirt through impact, water flow, and detergent. That is why Xiaomi has increased the drum diameter to 525mm this time; beyond providing more rotation space and centrifugal force, it also helps reduce. tangling. Now that we've covered the hardware, let’s move on to the actual testing phase. According to official specifications, the Mijia Smart Front-Load Washing Machine Pro offers a 12.5 kg washing capacity and an 8kg drying capacity. But if you've used a front-loader, you know the kilogram rating isn't very intuitive; it's mainly there so you can compare differences between models. In actual use, because the drum space is limited, a 10 to 12kg model is usually best for a small family of three to four .

The Mijia Smart Washing Machine Pro currently offers over 30 washing modes. From my experience, if you're just doing everyday laundry, you can just use the Smart Wash mode, and the system will automatically detect and set the cycle. I recommend going into the app and turning on the "AI usage habit recommendation" and "parameter memory" options. The system will then save your frequently used custom settings so you can quickly select them next time. I've also organized the other common modes for you, such as Quick Wash, Heavy Duty, Gentle, and Bulky. For high-temp sterilization or garment care needs, Xiaomi offers Air Wash, Fragrance Wash, High-Temp Wash, and Sterilization Wash. I find the Sterilization Wash to be a particularly special feature of this machine. In this mode, the system starts the cycle by activating 90 ° C high-temperature steam , which, according to the official specs , achieves 99.99%sterilization and 99.99 %virus removal, along with odor elimination. After the high-temperature steam phase, it proceeds with a wash using hot water. . If you have children, pets, or sensitive skin, the Sterilization Wash is a great choice. The Fragrance Wash is also quite interesting, perfect for when your clothes smell like hot pot. The system uses low-temperature steam and adds a small amount of detergent to refresh the fabric. Xiaomi's custom features are very rich; for example, when you select Sterilization Wash in the app. You can further customize the soak time, and the water temperature can be set to 40, 60, or a maximum of 80 degrees. The rinse count can be adjusted up to 5. times. The spin speed can reach a maximum of 1400 RPM. You can also choose whether to enable drying, with three levels available: " Iron" for slightly damp clothes, " Ready-to-Wear" for immediate use after drying, and "Storage" for bone-dry clothes you can put away right after the cycle. Another feature I really like is that this Xiaomi model supports an anti-wrinkle and freshness mode. Simply put, sometimes you finish a load but aren't home, which could otherwise lead. to wrinkled clothes. Once this feature is enabled, if you haven't taken the clothes out 30 minutes after the cycle ends, the drum will rotate to keep them airy. Also, in smart mode, you can add a steam care cycle. Beyond that, Xiaomi covers various common special needs, such as baby clothes, lingerie, new clothes, curtains , large items, sportswear, and performance gear.

For specific fabric types, Xiaomi also provides dedicated cycles like cotton/ linen, wool, down, synthetic, and silk. It is important to note that since this is a water-cooled drying model, I generally recommend only washing these special materials rather than drying them. Fortunately, Xiaomi has included a thoughtful safety mechanism in both the app and the cycle settings. For instance , if you select the wool mode, it only washes and doesn't offer a drying option , so you won't accidentally overlook it . By the way, if you're in a rush, there’s. a quick wash mode. Keep the load small—about one t-shirt, one pair of pants, and a pair of socks, roughly one to two kilograms—and the system will finish in 12 minutes. Now, let’s test the feature everyone cares about most: the drying function. As mentioned earlier, judging by Xiaomi's pricing, it's clear the Mijia Smart Washing Machine Pro is one of the most mainstream and relatively affordable water-cooled drying models available. Taking the machine apart, we can see the. Mijia Smart Washing Machine Pro is indeed a standard water-cooled dryer. Xiaomi uses a stainless steel exhaust pipe to prevent bacterial growth and minimize lint buildup. The principle behind water-cooled drying is actually quite easy to understand. We’ve shared an animation about it before, so let’s review it here. Water-cooled drying works by first heating the air with a module at the top of the machine, then blowing it into the drum. This raises the internal temperature,. turning the moisture in the clothes into steam and gradually removing it. This is where the magic happens. By injecting cold water to keep the cooling module at a low temperature, the high-temperature steam condenses back into water. Then, we take the opportunity to drain this condensed water away through the pipes. This allows us to gradually dry the clothes; the principle is very simple. I think you’ve all seen it now. So, overall, the biggest feature of the condenser drying method is its relatively simple principle and. straightforward structure, which is the main reason why every brand can produce a popular washer-dryer combo. However, it must be clarified that the drying temperature during the condenser process is relatively high. Using it for regular quilts, bedsheets, clothes, T-shirts, and pants is generally not a problem. Just be mindful of T-shirts with prints ; it’s recommended to turn them inside out or use a laundry bag, and unfold them immediately after drying. The most important point is to follow the laundry label instructions; never force-dry items, as it may lead to shrinkage or fiber damage.

It is worth mentioning that this Xiaomi model has built-in high-precision sensors, which is how it achieves intelligent drying. This means the system automatically controls the temperature, time, and humidity to achieve the three drying levels mentioned earlier, while keeping the temperature rise within a reasonable range throughout the process. Next, let's move on to a thorough drying test. We used our small family's two to three days 'worth of laundry, including two hoodies, four T-shirts, four pairs of shorts, two pairs of long pants, six. pairs of socks, and two jackets, then selected the "ready-to-wear" smart drying mode to let the system automatically determine the duration. We press start. Okay, the drying is finished. Through our tests, the entire load of laundry weighed about 4.25 kilograms before drying. After drying, it dropped to 4.2 kilograms. Since clothes are naturally absorbent, it is perfectly normal for them to be lighter than before drying, confirming that it can indeed achieve thorough drying. As for power consumption, a single drying cycle. measured by our external instrument used only about 1.77 kWh of electricity. At an average cost of 5 yuan per kWh, the electricity cost is only about 8 to 9 yuan. A reminder: if there is a notification for an update, remember to update so the system can display more accurate power consumption data. The drying result in "ready-to-wear" mode is quite sufficient. If taken out immediately like we did, the clothes might feel a bit damp, but it's within a reasonable range. If you are washing while away from home, remember to turn on the light-tumble function, which will yield better results. If you care more about smoothness, you can choose the ironing mode to iron them briefly before putting them away. We also tested a set of double-sized bedding along with four pillowcases; it was basically 80%full when stuffed in, serving as a bit of a stress test. Before washing, the set weighed 1.8 kg, and after drying, it returned to 1.75 kg , so it was indeed dried. Power consumption was 1.091 kWh; at 5 dollars per kWh, that’s about 5 dollars per cycle. Next is spin-cycle noise control . Using the same duvet cover and. pillowcases, we measured at 1400 RPM from one meter away. The peak noise was around 57 decibels, so the motor's noise control is quite good. By the way, if you want it to be quieter when washing at night, you can enable an additional mode. The app has a noise-reduction spin feature, but it's actually quite quiet even without it. Let's take a quick look at the app. If you want to control the washer via the app, for safety reasons, remember to enable remote control mode before.

starting every cycle. The door will then lock automatically to prevent children or pets from getting inside. On the app interface, Xiaomi helpfully displays your total power and water consumption at the top, allowing you to quickly check the status. In the mode section, there are over 30 modes as previously mentioned. You can tap into each one for a brief description to help you choose, or adjust further options. Next, you can select the detergent dispensing method and ratio here. If you. want to switch to laundry pod mode, you can adjust it here as well. If you want to change the 14 default modes on the machine, you can customize them in the cloud settings. For instance, if you don't need a delicate wash, you can swap in a down jacket wash instead. The AI usage habit feature was already introduced; remember to turn it on. The laundry history is quite interesting . Besides recording the mode and start time, you can tap in to see settings like soaking, temperature, and spin speed, making it very easy to review. By the way, the Mijia washer-dryer also supports OTA updates, so if new features are released in the future, the manufacturer can push them to your machine. Finally, regarding maintenance, a major advantage of these new Xiaomi models is automatic rinsing. Older models often failed to dry properly because lint would accumulate inside. This Xiaomi model automatically maintains the drum and fan ducts during each cycle to prevent dirt from drying and building up. At the same time, Xiaomi added a. dedicated water channel to rinse the door, preventing foam residue. So with normal use, just periodically run the drum self-clean cycle and open the filter compartment at the bottom right to clear out the lint. Alright, that's it for this episode. We’ve covered the most comprehensive hands-on testing in this video, so if you have any questions, feel free to discuss them below. I’m Donkey. We’ll see you next time. If you enjoyed this episode, don't forget to subscribe to Bunny and turn on the notifications to get our latest review updates. Of course, you can also find us on Facebook. at "Bunny Assistant," Instagram, and Line. If you have any other questions, don't forget to leave a comment below, and we’ll see you in the next video.

item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f-m0ozofg0E

值得閱讀的理由

  • 能快速掌握 Pixel 系列摺疊機在外觀、握持與多工體驗上的變化。
  • 整理處理器效能、遊戲表現、續航與充電測試，協助讀者了解實際使用取捨。
  • 涵蓋螢幕亮度、色準、PWM 調光，以及相機硬體與多款旗艦手機的拍攝比較。

摘要

外觀設計與摺疊體驗

作者介紹 Pixel 系列新機，並聚焦摺疊款在機身設計上的改進：外螢幕邊框變窄，轉軸側邊更平整，展開後則提供 8 吋大螢幕與分割視窗功能。機身採用玻璃纖維複合背蓋，重量由前代的 258 克降至 239 克，並具備 IP68 防塵防水；不過，作者也指出其摺痕表現與部分競品相比仍有差距。Pro 系列另加入可與 Gemini 互動的 Pixel Highlight 燈效。

效能、遊戲與續航

作者說明 Tensor G6 採用台積電 3 奈米製程與全大核 CPU 架構，Pro 機型配置 VC 均溫板。測試顯示，CPU 跑分較前代提升約 17%，但 GPU 與高負載遊戲表現仍不及部分競爭旗艦；日常操作則維持流暢。續航測試中，各機型皆能支撐長時間使用，整體足以應付一日一充。充電方面，Pro XL 支援 45W 有線快充，其餘機型為 30W，且全系列支援 Qi 2.2 25W 磁吸無線充電。

AI 功能與螢幕表現

相機與系統功能包含 Gemini、畫圈搜尋、AI 拍攝指導、團體照合成、影像修復等工具，也支援與蘋果裝置互通的快速分享。螢幕測試方面，作者指出各款面板在強光全白畫面下的亮度約達 2000 尼特，色彩準確度出色；Pro 系列的 PWM 調光頻率為 480Hz，標準版則為 240Hz。

相機硬體與實拍比較

作者整理各機型的主鏡頭、超廣角與長焦配置，並比較 Pixel 系列與 Galaxy、iPhone、vivo 等旗艦手機在日間、夜間、微距及長焦場景的成像。Pixel Pro 機型支援最高 120 倍專業變焦，標準款與摺疊款則提供最高 30 倍超級變焦；影片最後也展示多款手機的 4K 60fps 錄影畫面，供觀眾參考。

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f-m0ozofg0E

值得閱讀的理由

  • 能快速掌握 Pixel 系列摺疊機在外觀、握持與多工體驗上的變化。
  • 整理處理器效能、遊戲表現、續航與充電測試，協助讀者了解實際使用取捨。
  • 涵蓋螢幕亮度、色準、PWM 調光，以及相機硬體與多款旗艦手機的拍攝比較。

摘要

外觀設計與摺疊體驗

作者介紹 Pixel 系列新機，並聚焦摺疊款在機身設計上的改進：外螢幕邊框變窄，轉軸側邊更平整，展開後則提供 8 吋大螢幕與分割視窗功能。機身採用玻璃纖維複合背蓋，重量由前代的 258 克降至 239 克，並具備 IP68 防塵防水；不過，作者也指出其摺痕表現與部分競品相比仍有差距。Pro 系列另加入可與 Gemini 互動的 Pixel Highlight 燈效。

效能、遊戲與續航

作者說明 Tensor G6 採用台積電 3 奈米製程與全大核 CPU 架構，Pro 機型配置 VC 均溫板。測試顯示，CPU 跑分較前代提升約 17%，但 GPU 與高負載遊戲表現仍不及部分競爭旗艦；日常操作則維持流暢。續航測試中，各機型皆能支撐長時間使用，整體足以應付一日一充。充電方面，Pro XL 支援 45W 有線快充，其餘機型為 30W，且全系列支援 Qi 2.2 25W 磁吸無線充電。

AI 功能與螢幕表現

相機與系統功能包含 Gemini、畫圈搜尋、AI 拍攝指導、團體照合成、影像修復等工具，也支援與蘋果裝置互通的快速分享。螢幕測試方面，作者指出各款面板在強光全白畫面下的亮度約達 2000 尼特，色彩準確度出色；Pro 系列的 PWM 調光頻率為 480Hz，標準版則為 240Hz。

相機硬體與實拍比較

作者整理各機型的主鏡頭、超廣角與長焦配置，並比較 Pixel 系列與 Galaxy、iPhone、vivo 等旗艦手機在日間、夜間、微距及長焦場景的成像。Pixel Pro 機型支援最高 120 倍專業變焦，標準款與摺疊款則提供最高 30 倍超級變焦；影片最後也展示多款手機的 4K 60fps 錄影畫面，供觀眾參考。

item.content:encoded:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f-m0ozofg0E

值得閱讀的理由

  • 能快速掌握 Pixel 系列摺疊機在外觀、握持與多工體驗上的變化。
  • 整理處理器效能、遊戲表現、續航與充電測試，協助讀者了解實際使用取捨。
  • 涵蓋螢幕亮度、色準、PWM 調光，以及相機硬體與多款旗艦手機的拍攝比較。

摘要

外觀設計與摺疊體驗

作者介紹 Pixel 系列新機，並聚焦摺疊款在機身設計上的改進：外螢幕邊框變窄，轉軸側邊更平整，展開後則提供 8 吋大螢幕與分割視窗功能。機身採用玻璃纖維複合背蓋，重量由前代的 258 克降至 239 克，並具備 IP68 防塵防水；不過，作者也指出其摺痕表現與部分競品相比仍有差距。Pro 系列另加入可與 Gemini 互動的 Pixel Highlight 燈效。

效能、遊戲與續航

作者說明 Tensor G6 採用台積電 3 奈米製程與全大核 CPU 架構，Pro 機型配置 VC 均溫板。測試顯示，CPU 跑分較前代提升約 17%，但 GPU 與高負載遊戲表現仍不及部分競爭旗艦；日常操作則維持流暢。續航測試中，各機型皆能支撐長時間使用，整體足以應付一日一充。充電方面，Pro XL 支援 45W 有線快充，其餘機型為 30W，且全系列支援 Qi 2.2 25W 磁吸無線充電。

AI 功能與螢幕表現

相機與系統功能包含 Gemini、畫圈搜尋、AI 拍攝指導、團體照合成、影像修復等工具，也支援與蘋果裝置互通的快速分享。螢幕測試方面，作者指出各款面板在強光全白畫面下的亮度約達 2000 尼特，色彩準確度出色；Pro 系列的 PWM 調光頻率為 480Hz，標準版則為 240Hz。

相機硬體與實拍比較

作者整理各機型的主鏡頭、超廣角與長焦配置，並比較 Pixel 系列與 Galaxy、iPhone、vivo 等旗艦手機在日間、夜間、微距及長焦場景的成像。Pixel Pro 機型支援最高 120 倍專業變焦，標準款與摺疊款則提供最高 30 倍超級變焦；影片最後也展示多款手機的 4K 60fps 錄影畫面，供觀眾參考。
