item.description:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aL3wWyJmwWo

值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解滾筒拖地機器人如何邊拖邊清潔滾筒，並改善醬料、寵物腳印等髒污的清理效果。
  • 掌握 Roborock Qrevo Edge 2 Flow 的主要升級，包括薄型機身、吸力提升、第二代滾筒拖布與高溫自清潔。
  • 認識 AI 視覺辨識、避障、地毯防濕及防纏毛設計等實用功能，評估它是否適合居家清潔需求。

摘要

滾筒拖布與新一代機身

Donkey 以蠔油清潔示範比較雙圓盤拖布與滾筒拖布：傳統拖布往往得反覆清洗才能處理大面積髒污，而滾筒能在拖地時持續自我清潔，因而更有機會一次清除醬料、寵物腳印與地板污漬。Roborock 推出的 Qrevo Edge 2 Flow，則把新一代滾筒拖地系統與更纖薄的機身結合。

升級版滾筒拖地系統

新機改用可升降 LDS 定位模組，機身高度從前代約 11.9 公分縮減至 8.98 公分，有助於進入低矮家具下方；即使 LDS 降下，機身前方的定位視窗仍可協助辨識環境。吸力也從前代 20,000Pa 提高至 35,000Pa。

拖地部分升級為第二代 SpiraFlow 2.0 滾筒系統：機身內加入加壓供水，出水口從 8 個增加至 16 個，使長達 27 公分的滾筒能更均勻補水。柔性刮水結構則有助於刮除污水、控制水量並減少拖後水痕；污水回收設計也能將固體髒污隔離，降低系統堵塞機率。污水盒取消多餘凹槽與濾網，滾筒可一鍵拆卸，支架亦可抬起清潔，維護更方便。

貼邊清潔、避障與智慧策略

滾筒下壓力最高達 15N，並可伸出最多 4.4 公分進行貼邊清潔；遇到地毯時，系統會抬起滾筒並降下滾筒護罩，隔開濕區與乾區。機器人搭載單線結構光、邊緣感測器與 RGB AI 視覺模組，可辨識超過 280 種障礙物，前置補光燈則讓它在較暗環境中仍能辨識物品。

例如辨識到充電線時，機器人會在地圖標示並提前避開；遇到地上的醬油，則會抬起側刷與主刷、關閉風扇，只用滾筒拖布深度清潔，之後先返回基座清洗再繼續工作。它也支援窗簾清潔策略，以及暫時略過被人或寵物擋住的區域、稍後再回頭補掃；寵物用品區則可開啟加強清潔。

防纏毛設計與基座維護

底部採用防纏繞萬向輪、雙懸臂主刷與長短弧形側刷等設計。主刷中央留有空隙，讓毛髮在清掃時往中間集中並落入集塵盒；安裝時須保留中央空隙，才能發揮最佳效果。側刷碰到邊緣時會高速反轉，試圖將角落碎屑帶出。電池容量為 5,400mAh，實際續航則留待後續測試。

基座具備自動集塵、補水、污水收集與除臭模組，但沒有內建清潔劑模組，使用者須依指定比例自行將清潔劑加入水箱。機器人回站清洗滾筒時，系統會以最高 75°C 熱水沖洗，並透過加壓出水口清潔；多數污水會被回收到基座污水箱，減少滾筒浸泡在髒水中的情形。清洗後再以 63°C 熱風烘乾；今年的斜坡與底盤也可拆下沖洗。

後續實測預告

Donkey 表示，產品功能介紹告一段落後，影片將進行 15 項嚴格測試，完整呈現實測過程與優缺點；不過目前提供的內容尚未包含測試結果。Donkey 也提到，Roborock 清潔機器人社群成員已超過 66,000 人。

================================================

Traditional dual-disc mops can only spread oyster sauce evenly and cannot handle it. But Roborock's latest high-end roller mop handles even oyster sauce with ease. That 's right, Roborock has finally brought us their new generation of high-end roller mops, the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow! Hi, welcome back, I'm Donkey. Friends who want to clean their floors are certainly familiar with roller mops. As our opening demonstration clearly showed,. traditional dual-disc mops can only handle large areas of dirt by repeatedly rinsing the mop. But with a roller mop, even a whole oyster sauce can be cleaned in one go with ease. However, cleaning oyster sauce isn't the key point. The most important aspect of a roller mop is that it cleans itself while mopping, allowing it to clean even a whole oyster sauce in one pass. Not to mention, when cleaning your floor, the roller is constantly self-cleaning , better handling. advanced scenarios like pet paw odor and floor stains. This is why Roborock generated so much discussion in Bonnie's robot community when they launched their first roller mop, the Qrevo Curv 2 Flow, in 2026. Nowadays, if you want a truly thorough cleaning , you should prioritize a robotic vacuum cleaner. The biggest highlight of the newly launched Qrevo Edge 2 Flow this year is that Roborock has eliminated the protruding LDS positioning module. and replaced it with a new generation of lifting LDS. This has drastically reduced the Edge 2 Flow's overall thickness from nearly 12 cm (11.9 cm) in the previous generation to less than 9 cm (only 8.98 cm ), making it the thinnest front-loading robotic vacuum cleaner in Taiwan. This is definitely good news for those who need to clean low furniture. Incidentally, to accommodate the lifting LDS design, Roborock has also added a positioning window at the front of the robot. So even after the LDS module is lowered, the robot can still detect the environment about 100 degrees in front of it. through the small front window to continue positioning in low-ceilinged spaces. Those who don't want to use the lifting function can also turn it off in the app. But that's not all. Next, as usual, we 'll summarize the Roborock Qrevo Edge 2 Flow for you. The main highlights are : First, the suction power of the Roborock vacuum module has been further increased from 20,000Pa in the previous generation to 35,000Pa, meeting the high-end standard of 2026. We'll see the actual performance in real-world testing later. For.

mopping, the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow has been upgraded to Roborock's second-generation SpiraFlow 2.0 roller washing system. There are three major changes: First, Roborock's second- generation roller wash has added a pressurized module inside the body. Compared to previous roller wash models that could only replenish water through dripping , the second-generation roller module can now pressurize , providing a more stable and even supply of clean water to the roller. Importantly, it's not just about pressurization. ; Roborock has also doubled the original 8 water outlets to 16 pressurized water outlets. These two upgrades are significant for this 27cm long... For a roller mop, the evenness of water replenishment is significantly improved , and the self-cleaning effect of the roller itself is also enhanced. In addition, Roborock also uses a flexible wastewater recycling squeegee module. This slight elasticity not only allows the squeegee to fit more closely to the roller and scrape off dirt, but also, more importantly , it can achieve more stable water control. and reduce water stains after mopping. Speaking of which, Roborock's wastewater filtration is quite good . The squeegee itself is integrated with a whole water guide channel, so all solid dirt is blocked outside the filter screen and will not clog the entire wastewater recycling system due to small objects getting stuck. You just need to remember to take out the filter strip and the wastewater box at the rear of the car regularly for a rinse. It is worth mentioning that Roborock has improved the design of the wastewater box this time. They have removed unnecessary grooves and filters , and the top cover can be pulled out completely. , making it easier to clean. In terms of maintenance, the roller can be removed with one click, and the bracket module can also be lifted for easier cleaning. Overall, the entire logic of the Roborock 2nd generation is obviously more mature, the water output evenness has been improved, and the wastewater recycling system is easier to maintain . It has indeed brought the roller mop series back to the high-end track in 2026. In terms of floor cleaning efficiency, this roller has been further upgraded to a higher 240. It also boasts a powerful 15N downward pressure. to thoroughly clean dirt from the floor. Furthermore, as a high-end roller from Roborock, it features a telescopic edge-cleaning design. When the robot detects an object's edge, the roller can extend up to 4.4cm for edge-cleaning. But that's not all; the essential 15mm roller lift and roller shield hardware for high-end rollers are also present in the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow. So, as you can see in the video, when the robot encounters a carpet, the system automatically lifts the roller module and lowers the built-in roller shield,.

physically separating wet and dry areas. Okay, now that we've covered Roborock's second-generation roller, let's continue. First, in terms of the main positioning solution , the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow uses a lifting LDS module for rapid spatial detection , lowering the body to 8.98cm. Regarding obstacle avoidance hardware , we can see through the infrared camera that Roborock uses a single-line structured light module on the front for rapid obstacle detection , while the sides have edge sensors. for edge-sensing. In addition, the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow also features Roborock's signature AI... The RGB visual recognition module can recognize over 280 types of obstacles , and it also has a built-in fill light at the front , so the visual module can continue to recognize obstacles even in low light . For example, when the AI ​​recognizes a charging cable, it will mark the cable on the map , and the robot will choose to avoid it from a distance. By the way, this lens also supports classic Roborock functions such as video calls and pet capture. However, compared to video calls, the greatest value of this lens is that it allows the robot to see the real world and then intelligently adjust its cleaning strategy . For example, when the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow sees a puddle of soy sauce on the floor, the AI ​​will immediately raise the two side brushes, raise the main brush , and turn off the fan. Next, use only the roller mop for deep cleaning to prevent the robot from getting soy sauce on it . After cleaning heavily soiled areas, the robot will immediately go home to wash itself before continuing to clean. Not only that, the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow. also supports curtain cleaning strategies and a very practical pet/human obstruction cleaning feature. For example, when the robot is cleaning, it may be blocked by children or pets, so it will temporarily abandon that area and clean other places first , then return to clean up the missed spots later. Additionally, pet owners can enable the deep cleaning option for pet supplies , which will automatically enhance the cleaning of that area. Next, we flip the Qrevo Edge 2 over. The Flow also uses Roborock's signature three-anti-tangle design,. including anti-tangle omnidirectional wheels and anti-tangle dual cantilever brushes. The principle is to leave a gap in the middle of the main brush; during cleaning, hair automatically gathers towards the center and eventually falls off and is collected in the dustbin, achieving physical anti-tangle. The only thing to note is that when installing the main brush, remember to leave a gap in the middle for optimal anti-tangle performance. Finally, Roborock also uses two sets of long and short curved anti-tangle side brushes, allowing hair to fall off naturally during rotation.

Interestingly, these side brushes automatically reverse at high speed when touching edges , trying to sweep up debris from corners and improving edge-touching performance. In terms of battery life, the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow uses a 5400mAh battery; we will test its actual performance later. Finally, we see the base station section of the Qrevo Edge 2. The Flow also features built-in automatic dust collection, automatic water tank replenishment , a wastewater tank, and a deodorization module to reduce wastewater odor. However, this generation does not have a built-in detergent module. ; users can add detergent directly to the water tank according to the specified ratio . The biggest change this time is that the Roborock also adopts a wastewater separation self-cleaning design. When the robot comes home to clean the drum, the system directly injects high-temperature water (up to 75 degrees Celsius) into the body and cleans the drum through 16 new pressurized water outlets. Importantly, most of the dirty water is directly recycled into the wastewater tank and pumped back to the base station's wastewater tank, reducing the problem of the drum being soaked in dirty water for self-cleaning. This is also the approach for the new generation of drums in 2026. After cleaning the drum, the system uses 63-degree hot air to dry it. And there's good news: compared to the previous generation , this year's Qrevo Edge 2 Flow... The ramp and chassis can be disassembled for cleaning. For pet owners, simply rinse it under the tap – quick, effective, and efficient . I'll stop here for now , but to truly appreciate its power, we'll put it to the test . In today's episode, we'll conduct 15 rigorous tests,. recording the entire process. The results are right before your eyes, highlighting both advantages and disadvantages. By the way, the Bonnie Helps You Sweep and Mop Robot community has officially surpassed (updated) 66,000 members! There are many genuine user shares and discussions. Thank you for participating! Whether you're considering buying, have already bought, or not , scan the QR code to join the Taiwan Sweeping Robot discussion forum , or check the information section or pinned comment for the link. Let's start with the design. This year's Qrevo Edge 2 Flow features a mainstream round body design , with both the main unit and base station in a simple and durable all-white color scheme, easily blending into any home. However, note that the glossy cover is relatively easy to scratch; those concerned should take note. For mopping, this generation offers 30 water volume settings. However, what's special about this model is that we can adjust the water volume via the app... Selecting the smart water volume adjustment function will allow the system to use visual recognition at the front of the machine to adjust the appropriate water volume.

based on the floor material , controlling water streaks . If you still want to adjust it manually, the rules remain the same: start with the lowest setting, test if it's not enough, and gradually increase the setting to avoid water streaks. Unless you have pets, the roller will smell after washing, indicating insufficient water volume. As we've said many times, the cleanliness of the roller is completely linked to the water volume. If there are any issues with cleaning, first increase the mopping water volume and switch the base station to a 10-minute soaking high-temperature wash to ensure the roller is clean. , but this will require more water. In addition, if you have hardwood floors, the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow also has a built-in cleaning function that moves along the floor direction, reducing friction in the crevices. As a high-end product from Roborock, this model also supports the Hello Rocky voice assistant; all voice commands can be viewed in the app. Roborock also supports the Matter protocol and can connect to Google Home, Google Assistant , Alexa, and Siri. Okay, now. that the key points are covered , let's move on to our new 15 In the first test of the practical application , we prepared three common household cleaning hazard items: 10 grams each of cookie crumbs, sunflower seed shells , and red beans, totaling 30 grams. These represented small, long , and round, heavier items, allowing us to observe the robot's cleaning performance and whether the side brushes would scatter the red beans. The test began, and we observed that the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow, with its intelligent cleaning strategy activated,. automatically increased suction power and used a cross-grid cleaning method when encountering large areas of dirt. However, the dual side brush design still resulted in some red beans being scattered, but fortunately, they were all recovered during subsequent cleaning. After the test, we weighed the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow. Originally 30g , the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow recovered 29.80g, achieving a recovery rate of 99.3%. This performance firmly places it among the top performers. The second test was a corner cleaning test. We again controlled 10g of cookie crumbs and evenly distributed them in a corner. The test began. As you can see, when approaching the corner, the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow's side brushes automatically reversed, trying to reach the edge as deeply as possible . Our actual measurement showed that the original 10g... Of the cookie crumbs recovered, 8.07g was recycled , representing a recovery rate of 80.7%. According to the database, the cleaning efficiency is about 60% without extension brushes and about 80% to 85% with extension brushes.

Therefore, the side brush reversal does indeed contribute to cleaning. For the third test, we measured the cleaning time. We also compiled all the test results into a table for easier viewing . Our tests showed that the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow can complete cleaning in about 4 minutes, regardless of whether the lights are on or off. Compared to the current high-end models that clean in about 5 minutes, this is a very fast performance. For the fourth test, the hair entanglement test, we directly measured the length of the long hair set at 70-80cm. and filled the test space with 1 gram of hair. Test started, test ended. This is a test that Roborock excels at. The hair was successfully separated without entanglement by the dual-arm brushes and the left and right side brushes . For the fifth test, the obstacle test, we first tested its performance with the lights on. As you can see from the image,. it successfully identified and avoided potentially hazardous items such as charging cables, extension cords, and pet poop on the floor. A small detail is that when the Qrevo Edge 2... When Flow passes near high-risk obstacles, you'll see it raise its little hands to handle them as cautiously as possible. If there's no risk of the robot getting stuck, it will boldly approach or even push away the obstacle to clean, conforming to mainstream cleaning strategies. The system also successfully cleans around circular or cylindrical objects. . If you're a more cautious user , you can set a less-collision mode in the app, where the robot will choose a more conservative strategy for obstacle avoidance. In the sixth level , we'll test it again with the lights off . For those who like to see infrared images, this is also a good time to observe how the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow's sensing module works. The results are basically the same as with the lights on , and thanks to the supplementary lighting, visual recognition continues even with the lights off. It definitely avoids obstacles. However, I still want to remind everyone to pick up larger pieces of trash before cleaning, open the doors used for map creation , and tidy up wires and other debris . My conclusion from testing so many robots is that no matter how advanced , it's impossible to clean without tidying up. So, tidying up is still necessary. In the seventh level, we'll test its mopping performance. Here 's a little tip: for small areas of dirt, you can use the app... Select the area you want to mop,.

and the app will show the floor cleaning option. This allows for small-area mopping , but be careful with roller mops. I've said many times that I recommend sweeping first, then mopping, or at most sweeping and mopping simultaneously . Never mop a large area at once. In pure mopping mode, the system raises the main brush and side brushes, then uses only the 27cm roller to mop. Even a large area of ​​oyster sauce is no problem for a roller mop . However, I still want to remind everyone that this test is mainly to verify the roller's effectiveness. If you often have this kind of situation at home, I suggest using the floor cleaner we tested earlier, as it's more practical. The eighth test is the noise test. Here's the table: The Qrevo Edge 2 Flow has five suction modes in pure sweeping mode. In silent mode, it's only 59 dB , but for daily use, standard or the third level is sufficient. I've said countless times that for most households, running it to the maximum won't get much cleaner , but it will damage the battery. The ninth test is the battery life . Our new robot test uses a unified standard; it can complete 23 consecutive cleaning cycles in the same space. The tenth test is the charging test. The Qrevo Edge 2 Flow takes approximately 2 hours and 50 seconds to charge from 15% . A full charge in minutes is sufficient compared to the typical four to five hours for a robot vacuum and mop, and around three hours for a high-end model . If the battery is low, the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow also has a resume cleaning function; the robot will quickly return home to recharge before cleaning the remaining areas. For the eleventh test, the roller cleaning, we went straight to the "devil's challenge" —immersing the roller entirely in a mixture of soy sauce and soy paste. Here's the before and after picture of the clean roller . Next, we used the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow's new self-cleaning system at a high temperature of up to 75 degrees Celsius. The results are clear from the image: the roller was thoroughly cleaned. For the twelfth test, the base station dust collection,. we used 30g of mixed debris plus a half-filled bag of dog hair to collect dust. The Qrevo Edge 2 Flow's dust collection performance was also excellent. For the thirteenth test, the carpet test , our tests showed that when the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow encountered a short-pile carpet.

, the rear roller module automatically raised by 15mm , and the roller cover automatically lowered, achieving dry and wet separation . For the long-haired section, the same method applies without any problems. For those with carpets, you can enable the "Carpet First, Carpet Pressure Increase , Carpet Second Cleaning " options in the app . The robot will then sweep the carpet first when the drum is completely dry , automatically increasing suction power and using a cross-grid cleaning method. for a more thorough cleaning. If you bought it specifically for carpets or have large carpets or long-haired carpets, I highly recommend the Saros 20. It's arguably the Roborock flagship with the most comprehensive carpet cleaning strategy currently available. Finally, for the fourteenth obstacle test, Roborock officially states a 2cm threshold, so we tested a 2cm threshold without issue . If your threshold is a bit low , you can slightly raise it with a mat. or use a robot-specific threshold assist pad. In the final test, we tested the robot's ability to overcome the IKEA recliner obstacle. The test footage shows no obstacle getting stuck. Test OK! All fifteen tests completed. Overall, the upgrades to the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow are noticeable, including the replacement with a 35000Pa high-powered fan,. more in line with the 2026 flagship performance, and the second-generation drum cleaning module, achieving increased pressure and an upgrade to 16... The holes allow for more even water distribution , and the lifting LDS achieves a slim 8.98cm design. Combined with Roborock's already comprehensive smart cleaning strategy , those waiting for Roborock's slim roller should not be disappointed. As for the base station... Including essential features for high-end models like automatic water replenishment, automatic dust collection, 75-degree high-temperature cleaning with pressurization and self-cleaning , and a 63-degree hot air drying function. , it has everything you 'd expect . My only personal preference is the automatic detergent dispensing function , which would make it truly complete. Finally, I'm hoping that Roborock's first flagship drum floor cleaner will be released soon! Okay, that's all for this episode. We tried our best to test as much as possible within the limited time. If you have any questions , feel free to leave a comment below to discuss them. I'm Donkey, and see you next time!

以「邦尼幫你」為出發點，秉持著「科技很簡單，新奇可以好好玩」的初衷，以更多實境使用場景及戲劇內容豐富以往艱澀難懂的科技資訊，回歸消費者角度思考產品價值，並以「幫你玩、幫你測、幫你試」等實測內容給予產品評價，此外更期許能夠成為「更貼近消費者觀點」的內容創作者及具有媒體影響力的科技內容創造團隊。

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aL3wWyJmwWo

值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解滾筒拖地機器人如何邊拖邊清潔滾筒，並改善醬料、寵物腳印等髒污的清理效果。
  • 掌握 Roborock Qrevo Edge 2 Flow 的主要升級，包括薄型機身、吸力提升、第二代滾筒拖布與高溫自清潔。
  • 認識 AI 視覺辨識、避障、地毯防濕及防纏毛設計等實用功能，評估它是否適合居家清潔需求。

摘要

滾筒拖布與新一代機身

Donkey 以蠔油清潔示範比較雙圓盤拖布與滾筒拖布：傳統拖布往往得反覆清洗才能處理大面積髒污，而滾筒能在拖地時持續自我清潔，因而更有機會一次清除醬料、寵物腳印與地板污漬。Roborock 推出的 Qrevo Edge 2 Flow，則把新一代滾筒拖地系統與更纖薄的機身結合。

升級版滾筒拖地系統

新機改用可升降 LDS 定位模組，機身高度從前代約 11.9 公分縮減至 8.98 公分，有助於進入低矮家具下方；即使 LDS 降下，機身前方的定位視窗仍可協助辨識環境。吸力也從前代 20,000Pa 提高至 35,000Pa。

拖地部分升級為第二代 SpiraFlow 2.0 滾筒系統：機身內加入加壓供水，出水口從 8 個增加至 16 個，使長達 27 公分的滾筒能更均勻補水。柔性刮水結構則有助於刮除污水、控制水量並減少拖後水痕；污水回收設計也能將固體髒污隔離，降低系統堵塞機率。污水盒取消多餘凹槽與濾網，滾筒可一鍵拆卸，支架亦可抬起清潔，維護更方便。

貼邊清潔、避障與智慧策略

滾筒下壓力最高達 15N，並可伸出最多 4.4 公分進行貼邊清潔；遇到地毯時，系統會抬起滾筒並降下滾筒護罩，隔開濕區與乾區。機器人搭載單線結構光、邊緣感測器與 RGB AI 視覺模組，可辨識超過 280 種障礙物，前置補光燈則讓它在較暗環境中仍能辨識物品。

例如辨識到充電線時，機器人會在地圖標示並提前避開；遇到地上的醬油，則會抬起側刷與主刷、關閉風扇，只用滾筒拖布深度清潔，之後先返回基座清洗再繼續工作。它也支援窗簾清潔策略，以及暫時略過被人或寵物擋住的區域、稍後再回頭補掃；寵物用品區則可開啟加強清潔。

防纏毛設計與基座維護

底部採用防纏繞萬向輪、雙懸臂主刷與長短弧形側刷等設計。主刷中央留有空隙，讓毛髮在清掃時往中間集中並落入集塵盒；安裝時須保留中央空隙，才能發揮最佳效果。側刷碰到邊緣時會高速反轉，試圖將角落碎屑帶出。電池容量為 5,400mAh，實際續航則留待後續測試。

基座具備自動集塵、補水、污水收集與除臭模組，但沒有內建清潔劑模組，使用者須依指定比例自行將清潔劑加入水箱。機器人回站清洗滾筒時，系統會以最高 75°C 熱水沖洗，並透過加壓出水口清潔；多數污水會被回收到基座污水箱，減少滾筒浸泡在髒水中的情形。清洗後再以 63°C 熱風烘乾；今年的斜坡與底盤也可拆下沖洗。

後續實測預告

Donkey 表示，產品功能介紹告一段落後，影片將進行 15 項嚴格測試，完整呈現實測過程與優缺點；不過目前提供的內容尚未包含測試結果。Donkey 也提到，Roborock 清潔機器人社群成員已超過 66,000 人。

================================================

Traditional dual-disc mops can only spread oyster sauce evenly and cannot handle it. But Roborock's latest high-end roller mop handles even oyster sauce with ease. That 's right, Roborock has finally brought us their new generation of high-end roller mops, the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow! Hi, welcome back, I'm Donkey. Friends who want to clean their floors are certainly familiar with roller mops. As our opening demonstration clearly showed,. traditional dual-disc mops can only handle large areas of dirt by repeatedly rinsing the mop. But with a roller mop, even a whole oyster sauce can be cleaned in one go with ease. However, cleaning oyster sauce isn't the key point. The most important aspect of a roller mop is that it cleans itself while mopping, allowing it to clean even a whole oyster sauce in one pass. Not to mention, when cleaning your floor, the roller is constantly self-cleaning , better handling. advanced scenarios like pet paw odor and floor stains. This is why Roborock generated so much discussion in Bonnie's robot community when they launched their first roller mop, the Qrevo Curv 2 Flow, in 2026. Nowadays, if you want a truly thorough cleaning , you should prioritize a robotic vacuum cleaner. The biggest highlight of the newly launched Qrevo Edge 2 Flow this year is that Roborock has eliminated the protruding LDS positioning module. and replaced it with a new generation of lifting LDS. This has drastically reduced the Edge 2 Flow's overall thickness from nearly 12 cm (11.9 cm) in the previous generation to less than 9 cm (only 8.98 cm ), making it the thinnest front-loading robotic vacuum cleaner in Taiwan. This is definitely good news for those who need to clean low furniture. Incidentally, to accommodate the lifting LDS design, Roborock has also added a positioning window at the front of the robot. So even after the LDS module is lowered, the robot can still detect the environment about 100 degrees in front of it. through the small front window to continue positioning in low-ceilinged spaces. Those who don't want to use the lifting function can also turn it off in the app. But that's not all. Next, as usual, we 'll summarize the Roborock Qrevo Edge 2 Flow for you. The main highlights are : First, the suction power of the Roborock vacuum module has been further increased from 20,000Pa in the previous generation to 35,000Pa, meeting the high-end standard of 2026. We'll see the actual performance in real-world testing later. For.

mopping, the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow has been upgraded to Roborock's second-generation SpiraFlow 2.0 roller washing system. There are three major changes: First, Roborock's second- generation roller wash has added a pressurized module inside the body. Compared to previous roller wash models that could only replenish water through dripping , the second-generation roller module can now pressurize , providing a more stable and even supply of clean water to the roller. Importantly, it's not just about pressurization. ; Roborock has also doubled the original 8 water outlets to 16 pressurized water outlets. These two upgrades are significant for this 27cm long... For a roller mop, the evenness of water replenishment is significantly improved , and the self-cleaning effect of the roller itself is also enhanced. In addition, Roborock also uses a flexible wastewater recycling squeegee module. This slight elasticity not only allows the squeegee to fit more closely to the roller and scrape off dirt, but also, more importantly , it can achieve more stable water control. and reduce water stains after mopping. Speaking of which, Roborock's wastewater filtration is quite good . The squeegee itself is integrated with a whole water guide channel, so all solid dirt is blocked outside the filter screen and will not clog the entire wastewater recycling system due to small objects getting stuck. You just need to remember to take out the filter strip and the wastewater box at the rear of the car regularly for a rinse. It is worth mentioning that Roborock has improved the design of the wastewater box this time. They have removed unnecessary grooves and filters , and the top cover can be pulled out completely. , making it easier to clean. In terms of maintenance, the roller can be removed with one click, and the bracket module can also be lifted for easier cleaning. Overall, the entire logic of the Roborock 2nd generation is obviously more mature, the water output evenness has been improved, and the wastewater recycling system is easier to maintain . It has indeed brought the roller mop series back to the high-end track in 2026. In terms of floor cleaning efficiency, this roller has been further upgraded to a higher 240. It also boasts a powerful 15N downward pressure. to thoroughly clean dirt from the floor. Furthermore, as a high-end roller from Roborock, it features a telescopic edge-cleaning design. When the robot detects an object's edge, the roller can extend up to 4.4cm for edge-cleaning. But that's not all; the essential 15mm roller lift and roller shield hardware for high-end rollers are also present in the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow. So, as you can see in the video, when the robot encounters a carpet, the system automatically lifts the roller module and lowers the built-in roller shield,.

physically separating wet and dry areas. Okay, now that we've covered Roborock's second-generation roller, let's continue. First, in terms of the main positioning solution , the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow uses a lifting LDS module for rapid spatial detection , lowering the body to 8.98cm. Regarding obstacle avoidance hardware , we can see through the infrared camera that Roborock uses a single-line structured light module on the front for rapid obstacle detection , while the sides have edge sensors. for edge-sensing. In addition, the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow also features Roborock's signature AI... The RGB visual recognition module can recognize over 280 types of obstacles , and it also has a built-in fill light at the front , so the visual module can continue to recognize obstacles even in low light . For example, when the AI ​​recognizes a charging cable, it will mark the cable on the map , and the robot will choose to avoid it from a distance. By the way, this lens also supports classic Roborock functions such as video calls and pet capture. However, compared to video calls, the greatest value of this lens is that it allows the robot to see the real world and then intelligently adjust its cleaning strategy . For example, when the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow sees a puddle of soy sauce on the floor, the AI ​​will immediately raise the two side brushes, raise the main brush , and turn off the fan. Next, use only the roller mop for deep cleaning to prevent the robot from getting soy sauce on it . After cleaning heavily soiled areas, the robot will immediately go home to wash itself before continuing to clean. Not only that, the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow. also supports curtain cleaning strategies and a very practical pet/human obstruction cleaning feature. For example, when the robot is cleaning, it may be blocked by children or pets, so it will temporarily abandon that area and clean other places first , then return to clean up the missed spots later. Additionally, pet owners can enable the deep cleaning option for pet supplies , which will automatically enhance the cleaning of that area. Next, we flip the Qrevo Edge 2 over. The Flow also uses Roborock's signature three-anti-tangle design,. including anti-tangle omnidirectional wheels and anti-tangle dual cantilever brushes. The principle is to leave a gap in the middle of the main brush; during cleaning, hair automatically gathers towards the center and eventually falls off and is collected in the dustbin, achieving physical anti-tangle. The only thing to note is that when installing the main brush, remember to leave a gap in the middle for optimal anti-tangle performance. Finally, Roborock also uses two sets of long and short curved anti-tangle side brushes, allowing hair to fall off naturally during rotation.

Interestingly, these side brushes automatically reverse at high speed when touching edges , trying to sweep up debris from corners and improving edge-touching performance. In terms of battery life, the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow uses a 5400mAh battery; we will test its actual performance later. Finally, we see the base station section of the Qrevo Edge 2. The Flow also features built-in automatic dust collection, automatic water tank replenishment , a wastewater tank, and a deodorization module to reduce wastewater odor. However, this generation does not have a built-in detergent module. ; users can add detergent directly to the water tank according to the specified ratio . The biggest change this time is that the Roborock also adopts a wastewater separation self-cleaning design. When the robot comes home to clean the drum, the system directly injects high-temperature water (up to 75 degrees Celsius) into the body and cleans the drum through 16 new pressurized water outlets. Importantly, most of the dirty water is directly recycled into the wastewater tank and pumped back to the base station's wastewater tank, reducing the problem of the drum being soaked in dirty water for self-cleaning. This is also the approach for the new generation of drums in 2026. After cleaning the drum, the system uses 63-degree hot air to dry it. And there's good news: compared to the previous generation , this year's Qrevo Edge 2 Flow... The ramp and chassis can be disassembled for cleaning. For pet owners, simply rinse it under the tap – quick, effective, and efficient . I'll stop here for now , but to truly appreciate its power, we'll put it to the test . In today's episode, we'll conduct 15 rigorous tests,. recording the entire process. The results are right before your eyes, highlighting both advantages and disadvantages. By the way, the Bonnie Helps You Sweep and Mop Robot community has officially surpassed (updated) 66,000 members! There are many genuine user shares and discussions. Thank you for participating! Whether you're considering buying, have already bought, or not , scan the QR code to join the Taiwan Sweeping Robot discussion forum , or check the information section or pinned comment for the link. Let's start with the design. This year's Qrevo Edge 2 Flow features a mainstream round body design , with both the main unit and base station in a simple and durable all-white color scheme, easily blending into any home. However, note that the glossy cover is relatively easy to scratch; those concerned should take note. For mopping, this generation offers 30 water volume settings. However, what's special about this model is that we can adjust the water volume via the app... Selecting the smart water volume adjustment function will allow the system to use visual recognition at the front of the machine to adjust the appropriate water volume.

based on the floor material , controlling water streaks . If you still want to adjust it manually, the rules remain the same: start with the lowest setting, test if it's not enough, and gradually increase the setting to avoid water streaks. Unless you have pets, the roller will smell after washing, indicating insufficient water volume. As we've said many times, the cleanliness of the roller is completely linked to the water volume. If there are any issues with cleaning, first increase the mopping water volume and switch the base station to a 10-minute soaking high-temperature wash to ensure the roller is clean. , but this will require more water. In addition, if you have hardwood floors, the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow also has a built-in cleaning function that moves along the floor direction, reducing friction in the crevices. As a high-end product from Roborock, this model also supports the Hello Rocky voice assistant; all voice commands can be viewed in the app. Roborock also supports the Matter protocol and can connect to Google Home, Google Assistant , Alexa, and Siri. Okay, now. that the key points are covered , let's move on to our new 15 In the first test of the practical application , we prepared three common household cleaning hazard items: 10 grams each of cookie crumbs, sunflower seed shells , and red beans, totaling 30 grams. These represented small, long , and round, heavier items, allowing us to observe the robot's cleaning performance and whether the side brushes would scatter the red beans. The test began, and we observed that the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow, with its intelligent cleaning strategy activated,. automatically increased suction power and used a cross-grid cleaning method when encountering large areas of dirt. However, the dual side brush design still resulted in some red beans being scattered, but fortunately, they were all recovered during subsequent cleaning. After the test, we weighed the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow. Originally 30g , the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow recovered 29.80g, achieving a recovery rate of 99.3%. This performance firmly places it among the top performers. The second test was a corner cleaning test. We again controlled 10g of cookie crumbs and evenly distributed them in a corner. The test began. As you can see, when approaching the corner, the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow's side brushes automatically reversed, trying to reach the edge as deeply as possible . Our actual measurement showed that the original 10g... Of the cookie crumbs recovered, 8.07g was recycled , representing a recovery rate of 80.7%. According to the database, the cleaning efficiency is about 60% without extension brushes and about 80% to 85% with extension brushes.

Therefore, the side brush reversal does indeed contribute to cleaning. For the third test, we measured the cleaning time. We also compiled all the test results into a table for easier viewing . Our tests showed that the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow can complete cleaning in about 4 minutes, regardless of whether the lights are on or off. Compared to the current high-end models that clean in about 5 minutes, this is a very fast performance. For the fourth test, the hair entanglement test, we directly measured the length of the long hair set at 70-80cm. and filled the test space with 1 gram of hair. Test started, test ended. This is a test that Roborock excels at. The hair was successfully separated without entanglement by the dual-arm brushes and the left and right side brushes . For the fifth test, the obstacle test, we first tested its performance with the lights on. As you can see from the image,. it successfully identified and avoided potentially hazardous items such as charging cables, extension cords, and pet poop on the floor. A small detail is that when the Qrevo Edge 2... When Flow passes near high-risk obstacles, you'll see it raise its little hands to handle them as cautiously as possible. If there's no risk of the robot getting stuck, it will boldly approach or even push away the obstacle to clean, conforming to mainstream cleaning strategies. The system also successfully cleans around circular or cylindrical objects. . If you're a more cautious user , you can set a less-collision mode in the app, where the robot will choose a more conservative strategy for obstacle avoidance. In the sixth level , we'll test it again with the lights off . For those who like to see infrared images, this is also a good time to observe how the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow's sensing module works. The results are basically the same as with the lights on , and thanks to the supplementary lighting, visual recognition continues even with the lights off. It definitely avoids obstacles. However, I still want to remind everyone to pick up larger pieces of trash before cleaning, open the doors used for map creation , and tidy up wires and other debris . My conclusion from testing so many robots is that no matter how advanced , it's impossible to clean without tidying up. So, tidying up is still necessary. In the seventh level, we'll test its mopping performance. Here 's a little tip: for small areas of dirt, you can use the app... Select the area you want to mop,.

and the app will show the floor cleaning option. This allows for small-area mopping , but be careful with roller mops. I've said many times that I recommend sweeping first, then mopping, or at most sweeping and mopping simultaneously . Never mop a large area at once. In pure mopping mode, the system raises the main brush and side brushes, then uses only the 27cm roller to mop. Even a large area of ​​oyster sauce is no problem for a roller mop . However, I still want to remind everyone that this test is mainly to verify the roller's effectiveness. If you often have this kind of situation at home, I suggest using the floor cleaner we tested earlier, as it's more practical. The eighth test is the noise test. Here's the table: The Qrevo Edge 2 Flow has five suction modes in pure sweeping mode. In silent mode, it's only 59 dB , but for daily use, standard or the third level is sufficient. I've said countless times that for most households, running it to the maximum won't get much cleaner , but it will damage the battery. The ninth test is the battery life . Our new robot test uses a unified standard; it can complete 23 consecutive cleaning cycles in the same space. The tenth test is the charging test. The Qrevo Edge 2 Flow takes approximately 2 hours and 50 seconds to charge from 15% . A full charge in minutes is sufficient compared to the typical four to five hours for a robot vacuum and mop, and around three hours for a high-end model . If the battery is low, the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow also has a resume cleaning function; the robot will quickly return home to recharge before cleaning the remaining areas. For the eleventh test, the roller cleaning, we went straight to the "devil's challenge" —immersing the roller entirely in a mixture of soy sauce and soy paste. Here's the before and after picture of the clean roller . Next, we used the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow's new self-cleaning system at a high temperature of up to 75 degrees Celsius. The results are clear from the image: the roller was thoroughly cleaned. For the twelfth test, the base station dust collection,. we used 30g of mixed debris plus a half-filled bag of dog hair to collect dust. The Qrevo Edge 2 Flow's dust collection performance was also excellent. For the thirteenth test, the carpet test , our tests showed that when the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow encountered a short-pile carpet.

, the rear roller module automatically raised by 15mm , and the roller cover automatically lowered, achieving dry and wet separation . For the long-haired section, the same method applies without any problems. For those with carpets, you can enable the "Carpet First, Carpet Pressure Increase , Carpet Second Cleaning " options in the app . The robot will then sweep the carpet first when the drum is completely dry , automatically increasing suction power and using a cross-grid cleaning method. for a more thorough cleaning. If you bought it specifically for carpets or have large carpets or long-haired carpets, I highly recommend the Saros 20. It's arguably the Roborock flagship with the most comprehensive carpet cleaning strategy currently available. Finally, for the fourteenth obstacle test, Roborock officially states a 2cm threshold, so we tested a 2cm threshold without issue . If your threshold is a bit low , you can slightly raise it with a mat. or use a robot-specific threshold assist pad. In the final test, we tested the robot's ability to overcome the IKEA recliner obstacle. The test footage shows no obstacle getting stuck. Test OK! All fifteen tests completed. Overall, the upgrades to the Qrevo Edge 2 Flow are noticeable, including the replacement with a 35000Pa high-powered fan,. more in line with the 2026 flagship performance, and the second-generation drum cleaning module, achieving increased pressure and an upgrade to 16... The holes allow for more even water distribution , and the lifting LDS achieves a slim 8.98cm design. Combined with Roborock's already comprehensive smart cleaning strategy , those waiting for Roborock's slim roller should not be disappointed. As for the base station... Including essential features for high-end models like automatic water replenishment, automatic dust collection, 75-degree high-temperature cleaning with pressurization and self-cleaning , and a 63-degree hot air drying function. , it has everything you 'd expect . My only personal preference is the automatic detergent dispensing function , which would make it truly complete. Finally, I'm hoping that Roborock's first flagship drum floor cleaner will be released soon! Okay, that's all for this episode. We tried our best to test as much as possible within the limited time. If you have any questions , feel free to leave a comment below to discuss them. I'm Donkey, and see you next time!

- Find X10 Pro Max【官方最新優惠】： https://s.isbonny.com/X10PM

本集邦尼帶來完整深度實測：同場集結 iPhone 18 Pro Max、三星 S26 Ultra 與 Google Pixel 11 Pro XL 展開多焦段與人像錄影大亂鬥，並實測全白哈蘇 230mm 增距鏡套裝的望遠威力！

本集將透過完整實測數據檢驗幾大核心重點：

1. 三顆 2 億畫素哈蘇四鏡系統：主鏡採用 2 億畫素 1/1.3 吋三星 HPC 感光元件（支援 UFCC 與 DeepPix 算法達 17EV 動態範圍、CIPA 6.5 防手震），超廣角破天荒升級 2 億畫素 1/1.56 吋三星 HP5 大底（124度廣角、支援微距），搭配 2 億畫素 1/1.56 吋 3X 潛望長焦（CIPA 7.5 防手震、支援長焦微距）與新一代 24 通道原色真彩鏡頭。

2. 專業錄影與哈蘇增距鏡套裝：三顆 2 億鏡頭全數支援 OpenGate 錄影（最高 60FPS 與 O-Log2），內建 4K 120FPS 杜比視界、哈蘇錄影模式與自訂 LUT 監看，並宣布原生合作 Blackmagic Camera；搭配專屬 230mm 哈蘇增距鏡可實現 10X 光學與 20X 無損變焦。

3. 台積電 2nm 天璣 9600 Pro 與 8000mAh 怪獸電量：配備 16GB LPDDR5X RAM，CPU 單多核效能較前代大幅提升超過 20%，支援遊戲旁路充電；內建 8000mAh 超大電池，支援 80W 有線與 50W 無線快充（台版盒裝直接標配 110V 80W 快充組與哈蘇同色保護殼）。

4. 突破 2000 尼特全平面護眼螢幕：6.78 吋 1.5K 1-120Hz（遊戲最高 144Hz）AMOLED 全平面螢幕，實測強光全白亮度突破 2100 尼特第一梯隊水準，低亮度具備真實 3840Hz 高頻 PWM 調光。

5. 滿配周邊與 ColorOS 17 AI 生態：冷雕玻璃霧面機身支援 IP66 / IP68 / IP69 防塵防水、超聲波指紋、雙實體卡 + eSIM、紅外線遙控與 NFC 門禁卡；內建 AI Photo Agent 自然語言修圖並支援與 iPhone 快速傳檔。
